spells.effect: Freezes the surface of a zone with a thin layer of ice. The zone becomes difficult terrain. Any target entering or moving through the zone must roll Dexterity + Acrobatics vs cast successes or fall prone (Knocked Down condition). Fire Magic applied to the zone reduces cast successes by the Fire caster's successes. Upkeep: 1.

default.name: Flowing Form
default.text: You gain 1 bonus die on Dexterity + Dodge rolls against Fire Magic.

spells.name: Frost Lance
spells.text: Cold compressed to a point and thrown. It gets into the target in more ways than one.
spells.effect: A lance of ice fires at a target within line of sight. On a hit deals damage equal to excess successes and applies the Chilled condition. On 3+ excess successes the Chilled condition escalates to Frozen (the target cannot move at all and loses their movement action until freed, which requires either Fire Magic applied to them or a Strength + Athletics roll vs cast successes as an action). Defend: Dexterity + Dodge.

spells.name: Water Shield
spells.text: Water intercedes between the caster and whatever is coming.
spells.effect: When an attack is declared against the caster, spend 3 mana as a Reaction to raise a barrier of rushing water. Roll Fortitude + Magic + Water dots. Each success adds 1 to the caster's DT against this specific attack. Against fire-based attacks, double the DT bonus from this roll. Against earth or nature-based attacks, the shield provides no bonus.

default.name: Water Walking
default.note: Attuned: holds 2 of your M/T while active
default.text: You can move across the surface of water and other liquids as if it were solid ground.

spells.name: Flash Freeze
spells.text: Sudden total freezing. Not cold. Frozen.
spells.effect: Water erupts from the ground around a target, instantly freezing them in place. Target must roll Fortitude + Endurance vs cast successes. On failure, the target gains the Frozen condition (cannot move, loses movement action, -2 dice to all rolls while frozen). On 3+ excess successes the target also takes damage equal to excess successes as the ice compresses. Fire Magic applied to the target reduces the successes on the freeze and can end it. Defend: Fortitude + Endurance.

spells.name: Quench
spells.text: Every flame in the zone goes out at once.
spells.effect: Water floods a zone and puts out fire. Every Burning condition on targets in the zone ends. Each Fire Magic effect in the zone (walls, burning ground, fire conjurations) loses successes equal to the cast successes, and any reduced to 0 ends. On 3+ successes the zone also becomes difficult terrain until the start of the next Upkeep Phase.

default.name: Deep Cold
default.text: A target that gains the Chilled condition from your Water spells also loses their free move while Chilled.

spells.name: Tidal Pull
spells.text: A wave that hits a target and pulls them back with it.
spells.effect: A wave of water crashes against a single target and drags them toward the caster. On a hit deals damage equal to excess successes. Any target hit must roll Strength + Athletics vs cast successes or be dragged 1 zone toward the caster per 2 excess successes (minimum 1 zone on failure). Defend: Dexterity + Dodge.

spells.name: Ice Armor
spells.text: Ice plate. It holds until it is melted. Which takes work.
spells.effect: The caster encases themselves in a layer of magical ice. Add cast successes to the caster's BDT against all physical attacks. Additionally, the ice absorbs damage: the first time the caster would take damage each round, reduce that damage by the cast successes before applying it. Fire attacks deal double damage to the Ice Armor, reducing the BDT bonus by the fire damage dealt. Upkeep: 4.

default.name: Slip Away
default.text: When you would be pushed, pulled, or dragged, you flow like water instead. Ignore the forced movement and move 1 zone in a direction of your choice.

spells.name: Blizzard
spells.text: Multiple zones become extremely cold and hostile all at once.
spells.range: AoE, up to Water dots zones chosen by caster
spells.effect: Ice and freezing wind blast across a number of zones up to the caster's Water dots. Caster rolls once. Every target in every chosen zone must defend. Each defends separately. All targets hit gain the Chilled condition. On 3+ excess successes, a target gains Frozen instead. Fire Magic in a targeted zone reduces cast successes in that zone. Defend: Fortitude + Endurance.

spells.name: Countercurrent
spells.text: An incoming attack gets turned around and aimed somewhere else.
spells.effect: When the caster or an adjacent ally is the target of a ranged attack or targeted spell, spend 6 mana as a Reaction. Roll Dexterity + Magic + Water dots. If the roll's successes exceed the attack's successes, the attack is redirected to a target of the caster's choice within range of the original attack. If the successes do not exceed the attack's, the attack proceeds normally. Cannot be used against melee attacks.

default.name: Absolute Zero
default.text: Frozen conditions from your Water spells can only be ended by Fire Magic that exceeds your cast successes, and a Frozen target cannot use Reactions.

spells.name: Deluge
spells.text: A wave fills everything that can be seen. There is nowhere to go.
spells.range: All zones within line of sight
spells.effect: A massive wave floods every visible zone. Caster rolls once. Every target in every visible zone must defend. Each defends separately. All targets hit take damage equal to excess successes, gain the Chilled condition, and must roll Strength + Athletics vs cast successes or be pushed 1 zone in the direction of the wave. After the water passes, all affected zones become difficult terrain as water and debris remain. Defend: Strength + Athletics.

spells.name: Glacier
spells.text: A zone becomes a glacier all at once.
spells.range: Zone of caster's choice within line of sight
spells.effect: A massive glacier rises and fills the target zone entirely. The zone is impassable without destroying sections of glacier (each section has Vitality equal to cast successes, and there are 4 sections). Targets inside when it forms are Frozen and Pinned until the ice is destroyed or melted. Fire Magic reduces the glacier's Vitality by the Fire caster's successes per turn applied. Upkeep: 6.

knowledges.name: Air
knowledges.focus: Wind, speed, and precision. Ranged attacks and control.

default.name: Light Step
default.text: Treat every fall as one vertical zone shorter when working out falling damage.

spells.name: Wind Strike
spells.text: Wind with a point to it.
spells.effect: A focused gust of air impacts a single target in an adjacent zone. On a hit deals damage equal to excess successes. Defend: Dexterity + Dodge.

spells.name: Gust
spells.text: A targeted push of air with real force behind it.
spells.effect: A controlled gust of wind pushes a target in an adjacent zone. On 1 success the target is pushed 1 zone in a direction the caster chooses. Defend: Strength + Athletics. Can also be used to push objects or redirect projectiles (Storyteller discretion for non-combat applications).

default.name: Whisper
default.text: Send a short spoken message of a sentence or two on the wind to one person within line of sight. Only they hear it.

spells.name: Air Blade
spells.text: Air made sharp. It cuts.
spells.effect: A blade of compressed air launches at a single target within line of sight. On a hit deals damage equal to excess successes. Carries a minor bleed chance: on 3+ excess successes, target gains the Bleeding condition. Defend: Dexterity + Dodge.

spells.name: Deflecting Wind
spells.text: A wall of moving air that blows an incoming attack off course.
spells.effect: When targeted by a ranged projectile or physical ranged attack, spend 2 mana as a Reaction. Roll Dexterity + Magic + Air dots. Each success reduces the incoming attack's success total by 1. If the caster's successes fully meet the attacker's, the attack misses entirely. This does not work against melee attacks or magical targeted spells unless they have a physical projectile component.

default.name: Tailwind
default.note: Attuned: holds 2 of your M/T while active
default.text: Your movement increases by 1 zone each turn.

spells.name: Cyclone
spells.text: Everything in front gets blown back.
spells.effect: A cone of cutting wind erupts from the caster covering all zones directly in front and diagonally forward. Caster rolls once. Each target defends separately. All targets hit are pushed 1 zone directly away from the caster. If a target cannot be pushed (blocked by a wall or barrier), they instead take 1 additional damage. Defend: Strength + Athletics.

spells.name: Wind Sprint
spells.text: The wind pushes from behind. The caster moves faster than they should.
spells.effect: A burst of wind at the caster's back doubles their movement distance for this turn. This is not flight; the caster must still move along the ground. The effect is immediate and lasts for the turn only. No defend roll required. On 3+ successes, the caster may also choose to move through one zone that would normally cost extra AP (Difficult Terrain, Overgrowth, etc.) without the penalty this turn.

default.name: Eye of the Wind
default.text: Your ranged Air spells ignore dice penalties from wind, weather, and non-magical visibility.

spells.name: Tornado Bolt
spells.text: A miniature tornado shot in a line, knocking everyone it touches off their feet.
spells.range: Ranged, straight line through any number of zones
spells.effect: A concentrated tornado travels in a straight line from the caster, hitting every target in that line. Caster rolls once and applies the same attack successes to all targets. Each target defends separately. Any target hit is Knocked Down (prone). Damage is rolled separately after a successful hit. Defend: Dexterity + Dodge.

spells.name: Wind Wall
spells.text: A wall of wind that stops things from passing through it.
spells.effect: A sustained wall of wind rises along a zone border. All ranged physical attacks and targeted spells attempting to cross the wall must roll vs cast successes as a barrier. If the attack's successes do not exceed the wall successes, the attack is deflected. Any target attempting to cross the border must roll Strength + Athletics vs cast successes or be pushed back 1 zone. Earth Magic reduces cast successes by the Earth caster's successes. Upkeep: 3.

default.name: Updraft Leap
default.text: Leap up to 2 vertical zones, or across 2 zones, and land safely.

spells.name: Shearing Gale
spells.text: A gale strong enough to move everything in a zone at once.
spells.effect: A high-force gale tears through an entire zone. Caster rolls once and applies the same attack successes to all targets in the zone. Each target defends separately. All targets hit are pushed 1 zone away from the caster and are Knocked Down. The caster picks the direction for all pushed targets simultaneously. Can hit allies. Defend: Strength + Athletics.

spells.name: Fog of War
spells.text: A fog thick enough that ranged targeting becomes near impossible.
spells.effect: Dense wind-driven fog fills the zone. All ranged attacks and targeted spells originating from or aimed at targets inside the zone suffer a die penalty equal to cast successes. The penalty applies to everyone equally, allies included. Targets inside the fog cannot be clearly seen from outside. Melee attacks within the zone are unaffected. Upkeep: 4.

default.name: Gale Force
default.text: Targets your Air spells push or Knock Down are pushed 1 additional zone.

spells.name: Updraft Strike
spells.text: Up. Involuntarily.
spells.effect: A focused vertical updraft hits a single target, launching them into the air. On a hit deals damage equal to excess successes. The target is Knocked Down and lifted 1 zone directly upward (if indoors or in a covered area, they hit the ceiling and take additional damage equal to excess successes). When they fall back down on their next Upkeep Phase, they take falling damage unless they succeed on Dexterity + Acrobatics vs cast successes. Defend: Strength + Athletics.

spells.name: Sustained Flight
spells.text: The air carries the caster. They go where they choose.
spells.effect: The caster achieves sustained flight through magical air manipulation. While active, the caster can move in three dimensions freely. While flying they move at double their normal movement. Taking damage that exceeds their DT while airborne requires Dexterity + Athletics vs the damage dealt. Failure begins a fall, landing on the caster's next Upkeep Phase. Hovering costs half upkeep (3 mana, rounded up). Full flight costs full upkeep. Upkeep: 5.

default.name: Storm Crown
default.note: Attuned: holds 3 of your M/T while active
default.text: Ranged attacks and targeted spells against you lose dice equal to your Air dots.

spells.name: Grand Cyclone
spells.text: The wind takes everyone somewhere else.
spells.range: All zones within line of sight
spells.effect: A massive cyclone fills the entire visible area. Caster rolls once. Every target in every visible zone must defend. Each target defends separately. All targets hit are Knocked Down and pushed 1d10 divided by 2 zones (round up) in a direction the caster picks per target. Targets pushed into barriers take additional damage equal to excess successes. Defend: Strength + Athletics. The caster's zone is affected.

spells.name: Eye of the Storm
spells.text: A permanent storm with a quiet center. The storm belongs to the caster.
spells.range: Zone of caster's choice within line of sight
spells.effect: The caster creates a permanent zone of absolute tempest around a chosen zone, while the chosen zone itself becomes the calm eye. The surrounding zones (all zones adjacent to the eye) become impassable: any target attempting to move through them must roll Strength + Athletics vs cast successes each attempt, and failure leaves them in the current zone, taking damage equal to excess successes from the wind. All ranged attacks crossing through or originating from the surrounding zones automatically fail. The eye zone is completely calm. Upkeep: 6.

knowledges.name: Earth
knowledges.focus: Stone and terrain. Barriers and heavy damage.

default.name: Stonefoot
default.text: You gain 1 bonus die on rolls to resist being pushed, pulled, or Knocked Down.

spells.name: Stone Throw
spells.text: A rock. Thrown with magic. It hits hard.
spells.effect: A stone the size of a fist launches from the ground and strikes a target in an adjacent zone. On a hit deals damage equal to excess successes. Defend: Dexterity + Dodge.

spells.name: Earthen Shield
spells.text: Earth up in front of the caster. Gone after the attack.
spells.effect: When an attack is declared against the caster, spend 1 mana as a Reaction to raise a brief earthen barrier. Roll Fortitude + Magic + Earth dots. Each success adds 1 to the caster's DT against this specific attack. The barrier crumbles immediately after blocking.

default.name: Shape Stone
default.text: Reshape a small amount of stone or earth by hand: dig a hole, raise a step, seal a crack, or carve a handhold.

spells.name: Rock Barrage
spells.text: Several rocks at once. Still from the ground. Still going where they are aimed.
spells.effect: A rapid barrage of stones launches at a single target within line of sight. On a hit deals damage equal to excess successes. The sheer volume of stones gives the attack a secondary push: on 3+ excess successes, the target is pushed 1 zone away from the caster. Defend: Dexterity + Dodge.

spells.name: Rubble Field
spells.text: The ground becomes a mess of broken rock. Walking through it is a problem.
spells.effect: Shattered stone fills the zone, creating difficult terrain. Movement into or through the zone costs 1 additional AP. Any target entering the zone must roll Dexterity + Acrobatics vs cast successes or trip and fall prone (Knocked Down condition). Upkeep: 1.

default.name: Bedrock
default.text: Earth Magic defensive spells you cast add 1 more to the DT bonus they grant.

spells.name: Stone Spike
spells.text: A spike of rock explodes up from beneath a target's feet.
spells.effect: A spike of stone erupts from the ground directly below a target. On a hit deals damage equal to excess successes. Any target hit must roll Dexterity + Dodge vs cast successes or be pinned: they are Rooted until the spike is broken (Strength + Athletics vs cast successes as an action) or they take 1 damage to wrench free. Defend: Dexterity + Dodge.

spells.name: Stone Wall
spells.text: Stone rises between two zones and stays there.
spells.effect: A wall of stone rises along a border between two zones. The wall blocks movement across that border entirely. The wall has a Vitality pool equal to double the cast successes. Attacks that deal at least the wall's current pool value in a single hit bypass the wall. Fire Magic does not damage it. Nature Magic reduces the Vitality pool by the Nature caster's successes over time. Upkeep: 2.

default.name: Tremorsense
default.text: Until the start of the next Upkeep Phase, you know the location of every creature touching the ground in adjacent zones, even hidden ones.

spells.name: Boulder Crash
spells.text: A very large rock applied to a single target with a great deal of force.
spells.effect: A massive boulder conjures from the earth and crashes into a single target. On a hit deals damage equal to excess successes plus the caster's Earth dots as a flat bonus. Target must roll Strength + Athletics vs cast successes or be Knocked Down. If the target is already prone, they instead suffer an additional 2 damage from the full impact. Defend: Dexterity + Dodge.

spells.name: Tremor
spells.text: The ground shakes. Everyone on it goes down.
spells.effect: The caster stamps or strikes the ground, sending a tremor through their entire zone. Caster rolls once. Every target in the zone must defend. Each target defends separately. Any target hit is Knocked Down. Damage is rolled separately after a successful hit. The caster is unaffected. Defend: Dexterity + Dodge or Fortitude + Endurance.

default.name: Living Stone
default.note: Attuned: holds 3 of your M/T while active
default.text: Your skin hardens like stone. Your BDT increases by 1.

spells.name: Stoneskin
spells.text: The caster becomes partially stone. They are harder to hurt and harder to ignore.
spells.effect: Stone forms beneath and through the caster's skin, dramatically increasing physical resilience. Add cast successes to the caster's BDT against all physical attacks. Additionally, the caster's melee attacks deal additional damage equal to half the cast successes (rounded down) as the stone reinforces their strikes. The caster's movement is reduced by 1 zone while active. Upkeep: 4.

spells.name: Earthquake
spells.text: The ground around the caster becomes unreliable all at once.
spells.range: AoE, all zones adjacent to the caster
spells.effect: The earth shifts violently outward from the caster. Caster rolls once. Every target in any adjacent zone must defend. Each defends separately. All targets hit are Knocked Down. The affected zones become difficult terrain for the remainder of the scene (movement costs 1 additional AP). Defend: Dexterity + Dodge. The caster's zone is unaffected.

default.name: Unyielding Ground
default.text: Difficult terrain created by your Earth spells costs enemies 1 additional AP to move through, and you and your allies ignore it.

spells.name: Meteor Strike
spells.text: A great deal of earth falls on a great deal of people at once.
spells.range: AoE-4 (2x2 zone area), any targeted zone within line of sight
spells.effect: A chunk of dense earth the size of a room falls from above onto a 2x2 zone area. Caster rolls once. Every target in the area must defend separately. All targets hit are Knocked Down. Any target hit by 4 or more excess successes is also pinned under debris (Rooted until they succeed on Strength + Athletics vs cast successes as an action). The affected zones become difficult terrain. Defend: Dexterity + Dodge.

spells.name: Stone Fortress
spells.text: A stone fort rises from the ground in a turn. The caster is inside it.
spells.effect: Stone walls, roof, and floor rise around the caster's zone, forming a sealed fortification. The structure blocks movement across all four borders unless a gate is designated at cast time. The structure has a Vitality pool equal to triple the cast successes (split evenly across the four walls). Each wall section must be destroyed separately. Attacks targeting the interior must breach a wall first. Upkeep: 5.

default.name: Mountain's Weight
default.text: A target Knocked Down by your Earth spells is also Rooted until their next Upkeep Phase.

spells.name: Continental Shift
spells.text: The caster moves the world. Only a little. It is enough.
spells.range: All zones within line of sight
spells.effect: The caster moves the ground. Every zone within line of sight shifts by 1 zone in a direction the caster chooses (or different directions per zone at the cost of 1 additional mana per zone with varying directions). Any target in a zone that shifts must roll Dexterity + Acrobatics vs cast successes or be Knocked Down and take damage equal to excess successes. Zones that shift into other zones cause both to become difficult terrain. The caster's zone does not shift.

spells.name: Earth Titan
spells.text: The caster stops being a person and starts being a problem.
spells.effect: The caster's body is encased and augmented by a massive form of living stone, doubling their size and dramatically altering their capabilities. Strength and Fortitude each gain dots equal to cast successes (up to Earth dots maximum). All melee attacks deal additional damage equal to Earth dots. The caster gains immunity to Knocked Down and Rooted conditions. The caster's movement is reduced by 2 zones while active. Upkeep: 6.

knowledges.name: Nature
knowledges.focus: Growth, vines, and spores. Roots, terrain, damage over time.

default.name: Forest Sense
default.text: You gain 1 bonus die on Survival rolls in natural wilderness, and you can always identify a plant and what it does.

spells.name: Thorn Shot
spells.text: A thorn. Much faster than normal thorns.
spells.effect: A sharp organic projectile launches at a target in an adjacent zone. On a hit deals damage equal to excess successes. Defend: Dexterity + Dodge.

spells.name: Entangle
spells.text: Vines grab a target and hold on.
spells.effect: Vines erupt from the ground, seize a target in an adjacent zone, and drag them. On a success the target is pulled 1 zone toward the caster. Defend: Dexterity + Dodge. Outside of combat, Entangle can bind an unresisting object or tie down cargo, and the vines stay until cut.

default.name: Bloom
default.text: Make a plant grow a full season in moments: ripen fruit, sprout a seed into a sapling, or spread a vine across a wall.

spells.name: Vine Whip
spells.text: A vine that reaches and pulls.
spells.effect: A vine lashes out at a target within line of sight. On a hit deals damage equal to excess successes. Any target hit must roll Strength + Athletics vs cast successes or be pulled 1 zone toward the caster. Defend: Dexterity + Dodge.

spells.name: Spore Burst
spells.text: A burst of organic poison. Invisible. Persistent.
spells.effect: A cloud of toxic spores bursts at a target in an adjacent zone. Target must roll Fortitude + Endurance vs cast successes. Failure applies the Poisoned condition with a damage value of 1 per 2 excess successes (minimum 1). The Poisoned condition deals its damage value at each Upkeep Phase until the condition ends or the target is treated. Fire Magic ignites the spores and ends the condition but deals 1 damage. Defend: Fortitude + Endurance.

default.name: Thornhide
default.note: Attuned: holds 2 of your M/T while active
default.text: Thorns grow along your skin and clothing. Any target that hits you with a melee attack takes 1 damage.

spells.name: Thorn Barrage
spells.text: A wide spray of thorns. Messy. Effective.
spells.effect: A spray of razor-sharp thorns erupts in a cone from the caster, covering all zones directly in front and diagonally forward. Caster rolls once. Each target defends separately. All targets hit gain the Bleeding condition. Defend: Dexterity + Dodge.

spells.name: Vine Curtain
spells.text: A wall of vines that would rather hold than block.
spells.effect: A dense curtain of vines rises along a zone border. The vines block passage: any target attempting to cross must roll Strength + Athletics vs cast successes or become Rooted for 1 turn. On success, they cross but their movement for this turn ends. The curtain has a Vitality pool equal to double the cast successes. Fire Magic reduces the Vitality pool by the Fire caster's successes. Upkeep: 2.

default.name: Deep Roots
default.text: Targets Rooted by your Nature spells need 1 additional success to break free.

spells.name: Constricting Roots
spells.text: Roots that seize and keep tightening.
spells.effect: Roots erupt and seize a target. On a hit the target gains the Rooted condition. Each Upkeep Phase the target remains Rooted, they also take damage equal to the original cast successes as the roots tighten. The target may attempt Strength + Athletics vs cast successes during their Upkeep Phase to break free. Fire Magic applied to the target ends the effect. Defend: Dexterity + Dodge.

spells.name: Overgrowth Zone
spells.text: The zone becomes a problem for anyone who needs to move through it.
spells.effect: Dense plant growth erupts across the zone. Movement into or through the zone costs 2 additional AP. Targets entering the zone roll Dexterity + Dodge vs cast successes or become Rooted until their next Upkeep Phase. Fire Magic reduces cast successes by the Fire caster's successes. Upkeep: 3.

default.name: Plant Memory
default.text: Touch a plant and ask it what it witnessed in the last day. It answers with simple impressions of who passed and what happened.

spells.name: Barrage of Thorns
spells.text: The entire zone becomes hostile ground.
spells.effect: Thorns erupt from the ground throughout a zone, targeting all targets in it simultaneously. Caster rolls once and applies the same attack successes to all targets. Each defends separately. All targets hit gain the Bleeding condition. Defend: Dexterity + Dodge. The caster may exclude zones from the effect if they wish, targeting fewer than the full zone.

spells.name: Green Passage
spells.text: Branches part. Roots settle. The forest lets you through.
spells.range: Self and allies in adjacent zones, up to Nature dots in targets
spells.effect: The wild opens for the caster and their allies. While active, affected targets ignore difficult terrain created by plants or natural ground, cannot be Rooted by Nature Magic or plant-based effects, and gain bonus dice equal to cast successes on Stealth rolls in zones with plant growth. Upkeep: 4.

default.name: Virulence
default.text: Poisoned conditions from your Nature spells start with a damage value 2 higher.

spells.name: Grove of Thorns
spells.text: A spreading thicket that grabs and holds everything it can reach.
spells.range: AoE, up to Nature dots zones chosen by caster
spells.effect: The caster fills a number of zones up to their Nature dots with thorns and roots. In all chosen zones: any target entering or remaining must roll Dexterity + Dodge vs cast successes or become Rooted. Any target who is Rooted takes damage equal to cast successes each Upkeep Phase. Fire Magic in a targeted zone reduces cast successes in that zone. Upkeep: 5.

spells.name: Living Armor
spells.text: The caster is wrapped in something alive. It grows back when damaged.
spells.effect: Living bark and vine weave around the caster in a shifting organic shell. Add cast successes to the caster's BDT against physical attacks. When the caster takes damage while this is active, the armor regenerates 1 success to its BDT bonus at each Upkeep Phase (the natural regeneration maintains the shell). Fire attacks bypass the regeneration: each Fire attack reduces the DT bonus by the Fire caster's school dots. Upkeep: 5.

default.name: Verdant Path
default.note: Attuned: holds 4 of your M/T while active
default.text: Plants surge up wherever you walk. Each zone you leave becomes difficult terrain for enemies until the start of the next Upkeep Phase.

spells.name: World Tree
spells.text: A tree grows. Immediately and everywhere. The battlefield adapts to the tree.
spells.range: All zones within line of sight
spells.effect: A massive tree erupts from the ground and sends roots and branches throughout the entire visible area. Every visible zone gains the effects of Overgrowth Zone using the cast successes as the roll result. Any target in a zone when the tree erupts must roll Dexterity + Dodge vs cast successes or be immediately Rooted. The tree itself occupies the caster's zone and has a Vitality pool equal to triple the cast successes. If the tree's pool reaches 0, all Overgrowth effects end simultaneously. Upkeep: 6.

spells.name: Blight
spells.text: Everything green dies. The people in it follow.
spells.range: All zones within line of sight
spells.effect: The caster drains all living energy from the visible area. Caster rolls once. Every living target in every visible zone must resist. Each target resists separately. On a failure targets take damage equal to excess successes and gain the Poisoned condition with a value equal to the original cast successes. All natural plant material in the affected zones withers and dies, destroying any existing Nature Magic terrain effects in those zones. Undead targets in the zones are unaffected. Defend: Fortitude + Endurance.

knowledges.name: Bright
knowledges.focus: Radiance. Harms undead, buffs the living, transfers mana.

default.name: Sense Undead
default.text: You always know when undead are in adjacent zones, even when they are hidden.

spells.name: Radiant Bolt
spells.text: A flash of radiant energy. For most people, harmless. For undead, not.
spells.effect: A bolt of radiant energy strikes a target in an adjacent zone. This attack only damages undead targets. Against a living target it deals no damage. On a hit against an undead target deals damage equal to excess successes. Defend: Dexterity + Dodge.

spells.name: Glow
spells.text: The shadows have nowhere left to sit.
spells.effect: A flash of radiant light fills a zone. Every unlit non-magical light source in the zone (torches, lamps, candles) lights up and stays lit as ordinary flame. Any Dimmed effect in the zone ends if the Glow successes meet or exceed its cast successes.

default.name: Halo
default.note: Attuned: holds 1 of your M/T while active
default.text: A soft light surrounds you. Non-magical darkness has no effect on you, and you can light your surroundings at will.

spells.name: Light Ray
spells.text: Radiant energy with reach. It strips shadow from what it touches.
spells.effect: A concentrated ray of radiant energy strikes an undead target at range. Only damages undead. On a hit deals damage equal to excess successes. Additionally, any active Shade Magic effects on the target lose 1 success from their pool on a successful hit. Defend: Dexterity + Dodge.

spells.name: Blessing
spells.text: A sustained radiant enhancement that makes one kind of task easier.
spells.effect: The caster charges a target with radiant energy, providing a minor but persistent benefit. Add cast successes as bonus dice to one specified roll type (attack, defense, or a single Attribute + Ability combination declared at cast time). This bonus applies until the effect ends. Upkeep: 1.

default.name: Radiance
default.text: Your Bright attacks against undead ignore 1 point of the armor portion of their DT.

spells.name: Holy Burst
spells.text: A burst of holy light that sweeps a cone of undead targets.
spells.effect: A cone of radiant energy erupts from the caster covering all zones directly in front and diagonally forward. Only damages undead targets. Living targets in the cone are unaffected. Caster rolls once. Each undead target in the cone defends separately. Defend: Dexterity + Dodge.

spells.name: Beacon
spells.text: A light so bright it feels like courage.
spells.effect: Brilliant radiant light fills the zone. Living allies in the zone gain bonus dice equal to cast successes on all attack rolls. Undead enemies in the zone must roll Fortitude + Endurance vs cast successes at their Upkeep Phase or lose 1 mana. No one in the zone can benefit from darkness or Stealth while the Beacon holds. Shade Magic that meets or exceeds the cast successes dispels it. Upkeep: 2.

default.name: Inspire
default.text: An ally in an adjacent zone gains 1 bonus die on their next roll this turn.

spells.name: Radiant Wave
spells.text: The zone flares with radiant energy. Everything undead in it learns.
spells.effect: A wave of radiant energy sweeps through an entire zone. Only damages undead targets in the zone. Living targets are unaffected. Caster rolls once and applies the same attack successes to all undead targets. Each undead target defends separately. Defend: Dexterity + Dodge.

spells.name: Mana Transfer
spells.cost: 4 (spent by the caster; the amount transferred is separate)
spells.text: The caster opens a channel and lets mana flow. The only Bright ability that can do this.
spells.effect: The caster transfers mana from their pool to a willing target. On a success, the caster may transfer up to their Bright dots in mana from their own pool to the target's pool, without exceeding the target's Mana Pool cap. The 4 mana cost is spent on the casting itself and is not part of the transferred amount. Can target living targets only.

default.name: Purity
default.text: You gain bonus dice equal to half your Bright dots (rounded up) on resistance rolls against Shade Magic.

spells.name: Smite
spells.text: Radiant energy that hits an undead target with twice the force. Then strips their shadows.
spells.effect: A concentrated beam of radiant energy locks onto an undead target. Only damages undead. On a hit deals damage equal to excess successes doubled. Additionally, any Shade Magic persistent effects on the target end immediately. On 5+ excess successes, the target must also roll Fortitude + Endurance vs cast successes or be Stunned (loses their next action). Defend: Dexterity + Dodge.

spells.name: Turn Undead
spells.text: The dead remember, for a moment, that they were meant to rest.
spells.effect: A wave of radiant authority rolls through the zone. Every undead target in the zone must resist separately. Mindless undead that fail flee directly away from the caster for turns equal to excess successes. Undead that were animated or are commanded by another caster are released from that command for the rest of the scene. Sentient undead that fail lose their next action. Defend: Composure + Insight.

default.name: Aura of Dawn
default.note: Attuned: holds 3 of your M/T while active
default.text: Undead in zones adjacent to you lose 1 die on attack rolls.

spells.name: Consecration
spells.text: The zone is consecrated. The undead feel it immediately.
spells.effect: Radiant energy is pressed into a zone, consecrating it. All undead targets in the zone take damage equal to cast successes each Upkeep Phase. All living targets in the zone gain cast successes as bonus dice on resistance rolls. Shade Magic attacks aimed at targets in the zone lose 1 success before resolving. Cannot be dispelled by Shade Magic below the cast successes value. Upkeep: 5.

spells.name: Radiant Pillar
spells.text: Light falls everywhere at once. Every undead target in sight is addressed.
spells.range: AoE, all zones within line of sight
spells.effect: Pillars of radiant light descend on every visible zone simultaneously. Only damages undead targets. Living targets are unaffected. Caster rolls once and applies the same attack successes to all undead in all visible zones. Each undead target defends separately. Defend: Dexterity + Dodge.

default.name: Sanctified
default.text: When your Bright Magic opposes or dispels Shade Magic, your successes count double.

spells.name: Final Light
spells.text: There is no getting back up from this.
spells.effect: A column of pure radiant energy strikes a single undead target. Only damages undead. On a hit deals damage equal to excess successes tripled. Any undead Incapacitated by this spell is destroyed outright and cannot rise again. Every Shade Magic persistent effect in the target's zone ends. Defend: Dexterity + Dodge.

spells.name: Holy Ground
spells.text: The entire visible world is consecrated simultaneously. Undead cannot stand in it.
spells.range: All zones within line of sight
spells.effect: Radiant energy saturates the entire visible area at a level that undead cannot endure. Any undead target in any visible zone takes damage equal to cast successes each Upkeep Phase. Any undead who enters a visible zone takes the same damage immediately. The caster and all living allies in the area gain cast successes as a bonus DT pool against all attacks. Shade Magic attacks in the area lose 2 successes before resolving. Upkeep: 6. Cannot be dispelled by Shade Magic below the cast successes.

knowledges.name: Shade
knowledges.focus: Darkness and drain. Harms the living, buffs undead, drains mana.

default.name: Darksight
default.text: You see in non-magical darkness as if it were lit.

spells.name: Shadow Bolt
spells.text: Shadow with force behind it. The living feel it.
spells.effect: A bolt of shadow energy strikes a living target in an adjacent zone. Only damages living targets. Against undead it deals no damage. On a hit deals damage equal to excess successes. Defend: Dexterity + Dodge.

spells.name: Dim
spells.text: The light goes. Not all at once. But enough.
spells.effect: A breath of shadow snuffs out every non-magical light source in a zone (torches, lamps, candles). They stay out until relit. Any light created by Bright Magic in the zone ends if the Dim successes meet or exceed its cast successes.

default.name: Hush
default.text: Every sound you make is muffled until the start of the next Upkeep Phase. You gain 2 bonus dice on Stealth rolls during that time.

spells.name: Corruption Bolt
spells.text: Shadow that drains as well as damages.
spells.effect: A bolt of shadow energy strikes a living target at range. Only damages living targets. On a hit deals damage equal to excess successes. Additionally, the target loses 1 mana directly from their pool per success on this attack. The mana is drained and lost. Defend: Dexterity + Dodge.

spells.name: Shadow Cloak
spells.text: Shadows gather around the caster. They are harder to see. Harder to target.
spells.effect: The caster wraps themselves in shadow, becoming harder to perceive. While active, all targeted attacks and spells against the caster lose dice equal to cast successes. The effect is broken if the caster attacks or casts. Can be maintained through movement. Upkeep: 1.

default.name: Lingering Dark
default.text: Darkness from your Shade spells can only be dispelled by Bright Magic that exceeds your cast successes.

spells.name: Shadow Spike
spells.text: Shadow that leaves a mark harder to heal than ordinary wounds.
spells.effect: A lance of dense shadow drives into a living target. Only damages living targets. On a hit deals damage equal to excess successes. The nature of the wound makes it resist recovery: the next PHP the target receives this scene is reduced by the excess successes of this attack. Defend: Dexterity + Dodge.

spells.name: Fog of Dread
spells.text: The darkness fills the zone and stays. The living find it draining.
spells.effect: Thick supernatural darkness fills the zone. All ranged attacks and targeted spells from or aimed at targets inside the zone lose dice equal to cast successes. Living enemies in the zone must roll Composure + Insight vs cast successes at their Upkeep Phase or lose 1 mana. Undead allies in the zone gain bonus dice equal to cast successes on all attack rolls. Bright Magic that meets or exceeds the cast successes dispels it. Upkeep: 2.

default.name: Veil
default.note: Attuned: holds 2 of your M/T while active
default.text: While you are in a Dimmed or Darkened zone, you gain bonus dice equal to your Shade dots on Stealth rolls.

spells.name: Ethereal Shade
spells.text: A layer of shadow that limits how fast a living target can recover magic.
spells.effect: A layer of shadow energy locks onto a living target, suppressing their mana recovery. While active, the target's mana recovery is fixed at their base rate only, with no bonus for taking damage. The target cannot recover bonus mana through any means except direct Mana Transfer while this effect is active. Additionally, the target loses mana equal to half the cast successes (rounded up) each Upkeep Phase. Bright Magic applied to the target ends the effect. Defend: Fortitude + Endurance. Upkeep: 3.

spells.name: Shadow Step
spells.text: Where there is shadow, the caster can be.
spells.range: Any zone in darkness or shadow within line of sight
spells.effect: The caster steps through shadow, teleporting instantly to any zone within line of sight that is Dimmed, Darkened, or occupied by a shadow-based effect (Fog of Dread, Shadow Cloak, etc.). On 3+ successes, the caster arrives unseen for their first action from the new position (they may make one attack before being locatable by sight). Zones in full daylight without any shadow cannot be targeted.

default.name: Grave Whisper
default.text: Touch a corpse and ask it one question. It answers with what it knew in life, in as few words as possible.

spells.name: Mass Drain
spells.text: Shadow that reaches all living targets in a zone at once.
spells.effect: Shadow energy sweeps through a zone, draining mana from every living target in it. Caster rolls once. Every living target in the zone must resist separately. For each target, excess successes determine how much mana is drained from their pool. Undead targets in the zone are unaffected. Defend: Fortitude + Endurance.

spells.name: Animate Dead
spells.text: Something dead gets up. It does what the caster says.
spells.effect: The caster channels Shade energy into a recently deceased body (died within the last scene). The corpse rises as an undead under the caster's command for the rest of the scene. The animated corpse uses the base physical statistics of the deceased, with no magical abilities. It can attack in melee using the caster's Shade dice pool. It has a Vitality pool equal to cast successes. Bright Magic deals its normal undead damage to it. Upkeep: 4.

default.name: Hunger
default.text: Living targets that lose mana to your Shade spells lose 1 additional mana.

spells.name: Black Pulse
spells.text: Shadow goes everywhere. Everything living in sight feels it.
spells.range: All zones within line of sight
spells.effect: Shadow energy expands from the caster in a pulse reaching every visible zone. Only damages living targets. Undead targets in the zones are unaffected. Caster rolls once. Every living target in every visible zone must resist separately. Each target hit takes damage equal to excess successes and loses mana equal to half those excess successes (rounded down) directly from their pool. Defend: Dexterity + Dodge.

spells.name: Permanent Darkness
spells.text: The darkness becomes a permanent feature of the zone.
spells.effect: The caster presses shadow energy permanently into a zone. The zone becomes Darkened: all ranged attacks and targeted spells in or out of the zone lose dice equal to cast successes. Undead targets in the zone gain bonus dice equal to cast successes on all rolls. Bright Magic reduces cast successes by the Bright caster's successes but cannot fully dispel it unless the Bright caster's successes fully exceed the cast successes on a single cast. Upkeep: 5.

default.name: Umbral Form
default.note: Attuned: holds 4 of your M/T while active
default.text: Your body becomes partly shadow. While you are in a Dimmed or Darkened zone, attacks and targeted spells against you lose dice equal to your Shade dots.

spells.name: Eclipse
spells.text: The area goes dark. Not dim. Dark. The kind of dark that drains.
spells.range: All zones within line of sight
spells.effect: Every visible zone is plunged into absolute supernatural darkness. All ranged attacks and targeted spells anywhere in the area automatically lose dice equal to cast successes. All undead targets in the area gain cast successes as bonus dice on all rolls. All living targets must roll Fortitude + Endurance vs cast successes each Upkeep Phase or lose mana equal to excess successes. The Eclipse persists until the upkeep is not paid. Bright Magic that fully matches the cast successes in a single roll dispels it. Upkeep: 6.

spells.name: Soul Drain
spells.text: Shadow that reaches into a living target and pulls out more than mana.
spells.effect: A focused beam of shadow energy drives into a living target and pulls. Only damages living targets. On a hit deals damage equal to excess successes and drains mana equal to triple the excess successes directly from the target's pool. Additionally, the target must roll Fortitude + Endurance vs cast successes or lose access to their mana pool for 1 turn (they cannot spend or recover mana). Defend: Fortitude + Endurance. Willpower can be spent to resist the mana lockout: 1 Willpower negates it entirely.

knowledges.name: Battle Aura
knowledges.focus: Mana through body and weapon. Pairs with Combat Styles.

default.name: Surge
default.text: Push fighting spirit into your body for one Strength, Dexterity, or Fortitude roll that isn’t an attack, such as lifting, climbing, sprinting, or breaking free of a grapple. Each mana adds 1 die, up to the usual cap. Outside of combat, from Rank 2 on, one Surge can carry you through a whole extended task, such as a long climb or a day of hauling.

spells.name: Aura Fist
spells.text: The practitioner's fists or feet are coated in fighting spirit. Lasts for this action only.
spells.dice_pool: Attribute + Ability + Combat Style. Mana spent adds to declared roll portion.
spells.effect: Channel fighting spirit into unarmed strikes. Declare before rolling whether mana adds bonus dice to the attack roll or the damage roll. 1 mana per bonus die. Mana spent this way is capped at your Battle Aura dots or your M/T, whichever comes first. Defend: Dexterity + Dodge.

spells.name: Aura Blade
spells.text: The wielded weapon is coated in fighting spirit for a single strike.
spells.dice_pool: Attribute + Ability + Combat Style. Mana spent adds to declared roll portion.
spells.effect: Channel fighting spirit into a wielded weapon. Declare before rolling whether mana adds bonus dice to the attack roll or the damage roll. 1 mana per bonus die. The weapon's base rating is enhanced by the aura coating for this action. Mana spent this way is capped at your Battle Aura dots or your M/T, whichever comes first. Defend: Dexterity + Dodge.

default.name: Aura Edge
default.note: Attuned: holds 2 of your M/T while active
default.text: Your weapon and unarmed attacks gain Armor Penetration and Magic Penetration equal to half your Battle Aura dots, rounded up. They ignore that many points of the armor portion of a target’s DT, and that many points of the portion added by magic. This stacks with Armor Penetration from your Combat Style.

spells.name: Iron Body
spells.text: The body hardens with concentrated fighting spirit, reinforcing it against incoming strikes.
spells.effect: Channel fighting spirit into the body to enhance Fortitude. The practitioner adds mana spent to their BDT for as long as the effect is maintained. Upkeep cost is 1 mana per Upkeep Phase. Can be maintained alongside other Battle Aura effects.

spells.name: Aura Coat
spells.text: The weapon is coated in a sustained layer of fighting spirit that persists between strikes.
spells.dice_pool: Attribute + Ability + Combat Style. Mana spent adds to declared roll portion.
spells.effect: Sustain a Battle Aura coating on a wielded weapon across multiple turns. Declare before the first activation whether bonus dice are assigned to attack or damage rolls. This assignment is fixed for the duration. Upkeep cost is 1 mana per Upkeep Phase. The effect can be dropped and reactivated to change the assignment.

default.name: Aura Read
default.text: Read the fighting spirit of one creature you can see within a number of zones equal to your Battle Aura dots. Roll Perception + Awareness + Battle Aura. On a success you learn its highest Combat Style rank, its Battle Aura rank, and whether it means to fight you right now. With 3 or more successes you also learn whether it is hiding how strong it is.

spells.name: Aegis Pulse
spells.text: A sudden flare of fighting spirit at the moment of impact, hardening the body against the blow.
spells.effect: When struck by an attack that meets the practitioner's BDT, spend 3 mana as a Reaction to channel fighting spirit into the body at the moment of impact. Roll Fortitude + Endurance + Battle Aura dots. Each success reduces the incoming damage value by 1. Triggers after the attacker's damage roll but before damage is applied.

spells.name: Counter Pulse
spells.text: The practitioner channels their fighting spirit into an immediate counter strike following damage from a melee attack.
spells.range: The attacker, in an adjacent zone
spells.dice_pool: Attribute + Ability + Combat Style + Battle Aura
spells.effect: When taking a point of damage from an attacker in an adjacent zone, spend 3 mana as a Reaction to immediately return a strike against the attacker. Roll as a standard melee attack. Additional mana may be declared toward attack or damage as normal. The counter resolves after the incoming attack is applied. Defend: Dexterity + Dodge.

default.name: Aura Hand
default.text: Reach out with projected fighting spirit up to 2 zones away and roll Strength + Athletics + Battle Aura. Push or pull a creature 1 zone into an empty zone (Defend: Strength + Athletics), or lift, move, or hold an object you could lift with your own hands, such as opening a door or catching a falling ally.

spells.name: Aura Wave
spells.text: A visible wave of fighting spirit launched forward in a straight line.
spells.range: Ranged, straight line from caster through any number of zones
spells.dice_pool: Attribute + Ability + Combat Style + Battle Aura
spells.effect: Project fighting spirit forward in a straight line. The wave travels through every zone in that line. Every target in the line is hit and defends separately. The caster rolls once and applies the same attack successes to all targets. Damage is rolled separately after a successful hit. Additional mana may be spent to add bonus dice to attack or damage before rolling. Defend: Dexterity + Dodge.

spells.name: Aura Parry
spells.text: The practitioner projects their fighting spirit outward at the moment of an incoming attack.
spells.dice_pool: Attribute + Ability + Combat Style + Battle Aura
spells.effect: When targeted by a ranged or melee attack, spend 4 mana or 1 Willpower as a Reaction to project fighting spirit outward as a deflecting force. Roll Attribute + Ability + Combat Style + Battle Aura dots. Each success reduces the incoming attack's success total by 1. If the defender's successes meet or exceed the attacker's the attack is fully deflected. Usable against both physical and magical attacks.

default.name: Battle Presence
default.text: People near you can feel your fighting spirit without being touched. Add your Battle Aura dots to rolls to intimidate, and to your own rolls to resist fear.

spells.name: Aura Cone
spells.text: A fan of fighting spirit projected outward from the body, covering a wide forward arc.
spells.dice_pool: Attribute + Ability + Combat Style + Battle Aura
spells.effect: Project fighting spirit outward in a cone covering all zones directly in front of and diagonally forward of the practitioner. The caster rolls once and applies the same attack successes to all targets in the cone. Each target defends separately. Damage is rolled separately after a successful hit. Additional mana may be spent to add bonus dice to attack or damage. Can hit allies. Defend: Dexterity + Dodge.

spells.name: Aura Transfer
spells.text: The practitioner channels their fighting spirit directly into an ally, temporarily bolstering their physical capabilities.
spells.range: One target in an adjacent zone
spells.effect: Channel fighting spirit into an ally, temporarily enhancing one physical attribute (Strength, Dexterity, or Fortitude) by a number of dots equal to successes rolled, up to the practitioner's Battle Aura dots. Duration maintained by upkeep of 4 mana per Upkeep Phase. The practitioner must remain within one zone of the target to maintain the effect.

default.name: Empowered Flight
default.text: You can fly by projecting fighting spirit downward, following the Flight rules at the start of this section.

spells.name: Twin Wave
spells.text: Two simultaneous waves of fighting spirit projected in different directions.
spells.range: Ranged, two straight lines from the caster in any two directions
spells.dice_pool: Attribute + Ability + Combat Style + Battle Aura
spells.effect: Project fighting spirit in two straight lines simultaneously. Each line can point in any direction. The caster rolls once and applies the same attack successes to all targets in both lines. Each target defends separately. Damage is rolled separately after a successful hit. Additional mana may be spent to add bonus dice to attack or damage. Defend: Dexterity + Dodge.

spells.name: Aura Shroud
spells.text: The practitioner extends their fighting spirit outward to cover allies in a protective layer.
spells.range: Self and up to two allies in adjacent zones
spells.effect: Project fighting spirit outward to cover the practitioner and up to two allies in adjacent zones in a protective aura. Each protected target adds the practitioner's Battle Aura dots to their BDT for as long as the effect is maintained. Upkeep cost is 5 mana per Upkeep Phase. The practitioner must remain within one zone of each protected target. If a target moves beyond one zone away the effect on that target ends immediately.

default.name: Sovereign Aura
default.note: Attuned: holds 4 of your M/T while active
default.text: Enemies within a number of zones equal to your Battle Aura dots, whose Battle Aura and Combat Style ratings are all lower than your Battle Aura dots, roll Composure + Presence when they first come into range. If they roll fewer successes than your Battle Aura dots, they lose 1 die on all rolls while they stay in range. Outside of combat, anyone affected won’t start a fight with you unless they’re cornered.

spells.name: Omega Burst
spells.text: A total release of fighting spirit in all directions at once. Every nearby target is pushed back.
spells.range: AoE, all zones adjacent to the practitioner
spells.dice_pool: Attribute + Ability + Combat Style + Battle Aura
spells.effect: Release fighting spirit in an explosive burst radiating outward in all directions. Every target in any zone adjacent to the practitioner is hit. The caster rolls once and applies the same attack successes to all targets. Each target defends separately. Damage is rolled and applied to all targets hit successfully. Additional mana may be spent to add bonus dice to attack or damage. All targets, whether damaged or not, are pushed one zone away from the caster. Defend: Dexterity + Dodge.

spells.name: Aura Ascendant
spells.text: A total channeling of fighting spirit into the body simultaneously enhancing all physical attributes.
spells.effect: Channel fighting spirit into complete physical transcendence. Once active, all three physical attributes (Strength, Dexterity, and Fortitude) are enhanced by a number of dots equal to successes rolled, up to the practitioner's Battle Aura dots. All existing Battle Aura persistent effects are maintained at no additional upkeep cost for the duration. Upkeep cost is 6 mana per Upkeep Phase or 2 Willpower per scene. Ends immediately if the practitioner is incapacitated.

knowledges.name: Scroll Magic
knowledges.focus: Spells stored in scrolls to release later.

knowledges.name: Divination
knowledges.focus: Reading information from time, place, and connection.

knowledges.name: Summoning Magic
knowledges.focus: SumMonz, familiars, and calling items through circles.

knowledges.name: Teleportation
knowledges.focus: Instant passage between two prepared circles.

knowledges.name: Binding Rituals
knowledges.focus: Fixing effects, spirits, or entities to objects or places.

knowledges.name: Ward Magic
knowledges.focus: Protective or alerting circles on zones, objects, or thresholds.

knowledges.name: Augmentation
knowledges.focus: Building magic into weapons and gear.

knowledges.name: Spatial Magic
knowledges.focus: Folding space so containers hold far more.

knowledges.name: Time Magic
knowledges.focus: Slowing, speeding, or stopping time in a small area.

stats.name: Willpower
stats.used_for: Social combat health. Spend 1 per turn: +3 dice, or reroll 3 failed dice.
stats.gained: Checks from acting on your drives and holding firm. Full row of checks: +1 dot.

stats.name: Fate
stats.used_for: Weaving the story your way. Fate contests against opposing Fate.
stats.gained: Checks from influence, kept deals, and won contests. Never spent.

stats.name: Sanity
stats.used_for: Resisting the Void. Lost dots bring traumas; at 1 or 10 the Storyteller takes control.
stats.gained: Checks from living life, time with loved ones, and therapy.

stats.name: Mana
stats.used_for: Powers all magic. Pool = (Magic + Circle Magic) x Mana. M/T = Fortitude + Mana.
stats.gained: Freebies (7 per dot) or XP (new dot x7). Pool recovers each Upkeep and quickly between fights.

combos.name: Crushing Vine
combos.text: Living vines fed by flowing water seize the target and squeeze.
combos.dice_pool: Dexterity + Magic + Water dots + Nature dots (cap at lowest)
combos.effect: Water-fed vines erupt from the ground and constrict a target. Target is Rooted. Each Upkeep Phase the target remains Rooted they take damage equal to the original attack successes. The target can attempt to break free by rolling Strength + Athletics against the original cast successes during their Upkeep Phase.

combos.name: Cursed Ground
combos.text: Dark energy seeps up through the earth, corrupting the ground itself.
combos.dice_pool: Intelligence + Magic + Earth dots + Shade dots (cap at lowest)
combos.effect: Living targets in the zone must roll Fortitude + Endurance vs cast successes each Upkeep Phase or lose mana equal to the excess successes. Undead targets in the zone gain bonus dice equal to caster successes on attack rolls. Bright Magic applied to the zone dispels it.

combos.name: Decay
combos.text: Dark organic energy unravels the structure of an incoming spell before it can take effect.
combos.dice_pool: Intelligence + Magic + Nature dots + Shade dots (cap at lowest)
combos.effect: Cast as a Reaction when an enemy spell is being cast. Roll as a counterspell. Each success reduces the target spell's cast successes by 1. Can negate the spell entirely if successes meet or exceed the caster's. Against Battle Aura combination spells, Decay only affects the magical enhancement portion, not the physical attack component.

combos.name: Disruption
combos.text: Bright and Shade collide inside a spell as it forms. The result is collapse. The opposing forces tear the cast apart from the inside.
combos.speed: Reaction (declared when a target begins casting)
combos.range: Any target within line of sight
combos.dice_pool: Intelligence + Magic + lowest dots among combined schools
combos.effect: When a target declares they are casting a spell, the caster may spend 4 mana as a Reaction to attempt Disruption. Roll Disruption against the caster's Intelligence + Magic + highest casting school dots. On a tie, both spells fail. On a success, the target's spell fails and they lose the mana they spent. On excess successes, the target loses additional mana equal to the excess successes. If the target wins, their spell proceeds normally. Disruption may only be attempted once per casting. Willpower spent by the target adds 1 success to their defense roll.

combos.name: Dust Storm
combos.text: Wind-driven stone and grit scour the air, cutting visibility to near zero.
combos.dice_pool: Intelligence + Magic + Air dots + Earth dots (cap at lowest)
combos.effect: A churning cloud of mineral debris fills the zone. All targets in the zone suffer a visibility penalty equal to cast successes on all ranged attack and targeted spell rolls. Movement through the zone costs 1 additional AP.

combos.name: Flame Whip
combos.text: A crackling tendril of flaming plant matter snaps across the distance and drags.
combos.dice_pool: Attribute + Ability + Fire dots + Nature dots (cap at lowest)
combos.effect: A burning vine lashes out at a target in an adjacent zone. On a successful hit the target is pulled 1 zone toward the caster and gains the Burning condition. Defend: Dexterity + Dodge.

combos.name: Hallowed Ground
combos.text: The ground itself glows faintly with radiant force.
combos.dice_pool: Intelligence + Magic + Earth dots + Bright dots (cap at lowest)
combos.effect: Radiant energy is pressed into the earth and radiates upward. Living targets in the zone gain bonus dice on resistance rolls equal to cast successes. Conditions on living targets in the zone are suppressed for as long as they remain in the zone (conditions resume on leaving). Undead targets in the zone suffer a die penalty equal to cast successes on all rolls. Shade Magic dispels it.

combos.name: Magma
combos.text: The earth opens and bleeds molten rock across the zone.
combos.dice_pool: Intelligence + Magic + Fire dots + Earth dots (cap at lowest)
combos.effect: Molten rock covers the zone. Any target entering or remaining in the zone must roll Fortitude + Endurance vs cast successes each Upkeep Phase. Failure deals damage equal to excess successes and applies the Burning condition. Movement through or within the zone costs 1 additional AP. Water Magic applied to the zone reduces cast successes by the Water caster's successes.

combos.name: Mending Bloom
combos.text: Soft glowing blossoms spread across the zone, breathing light into those who rest within it.
combos.dice_pool: Intelligence + Magic + Nature dots + Bright dots (cap at lowest)
combos.effect: Radiant plant growth fills a zone. Each Upkeep Phase, any living target who remains in the zone is given a PHP (Pool of Healing Points) equal to the cast successes. Healing tier: Basic. The pool lasts until the end of that target's next turn, and any unused points are lost. The upkeep cost may be paid by either the original caster or any target in the zone. Shade Magic dispels it.

combos.name: Miasma
combos.text: A creeping dark fog that saps the will and precision of anyone breathing it in.
combos.dice_pool: Intelligence + Magic + Air dots + Shade dots (cap at lowest)
combos.effect: A dark mist fills the zone with a pool of penalty dice equal to cast successes. Any living target in the zone rolls against this pool before every roll they make, losing dice equal to the Miasma's penalty pool successes that turn. The pool depletes as it is used. Undead targets in the zone gain bonus dice equal to current pool size instead. Bright Magic dispels it.

combos.name: Mist
combos.text: Heat meets water and produces a rolling cloud of dense steam.
combos.dice_pool: Intelligence + Magic + Fire dots + Water dots (cap at lowest)
combos.effect: Steam fills the zone, reducing visibility. All ranged attacks and targeted spells originating from or aimed at targets inside the zone suffer a die penalty equal to cast successes. Movement through the zone is not impaired but targets inside cannot be clearly seen from outside.

combos.name: Overgrowth
combos.text: The earth erupts with a wall of thick tangled growth impossible to move through quickly.
combos.dice_pool: Intelligence + Magic + Earth dots + Nature dots (cap at lowest)
combos.effect: Dense plant growth bursts up through the earth and fills the zone. Movement into or through the zone costs 2 additional AP. The growth has a Vitality pool equal to double the cast successes. Fire spells or melee attacks with bladed weapons reduce the Vitality pool rather than targeting individuals. When the Vitality pool reaches 0 the growth is destroyed.

combos.name: Plasma
combos.text: Superheated plasma that burns through armor as readily as flesh.
combos.dice_pool: Dexterity + Magic + Fire dots + Air dots (cap at lowest)
combos.effect: A bolt of superheated ionized gas launches at a single target. Carries Armor Pen: the caster may declare additional mana toward Armor Pen before rolling. Every 2 mana spent reduces the armor portion of the target's DT by 1 for this attack. Armor Pen is declared separately from mana spent on attack or damage dice. Defend: Dexterity + Dodge or appropriate cover.

combos.name: Quagmire
combos.text: The earth drinks water until it becomes a sucking trap.
combos.dice_pool: Intelligence + Magic + Water dots + Earth dots (cap at lowest)
combos.effect: Water-saturated earth turns the zone into difficult terrain. Movement into or through the zone costs 2 additional AP. Targets entering the zone roll Strength + Athletics vs cast successes or become Rooted until their next Upkeep Phase. Rooted targets who attempt to move roll Strength + Athletics against cast successes; success allows movement at cost, failure keeps them Rooted.

combos.name: Radiant Flame
combos.text: Fire touched by radiant energy. In attack form it burns twice as bright against the dead. In utility form it simply burns, clean and permanent.
combos.dice_pool: Dexterity + Magic + Fire dots + Bright dots (cap at lowest) for attack mode, Intelligence in place of Dexterity for utility mode
combos.effect: Declare attack or utility mode before casting. Attack mode: deals damage; successes are doubled against undead. Utility mode: creates a sustained area of radiant fire that cannot be mechanically extinguished and deals no harm to living targets. The light dispels mundane darkness and Shade-based obscuring effects. Shade Magic does not extinguish it.

combos.name: Radiant Wind
combos.text: Glowing wind that lofts projectiles and steadies aim.
combos.dice_pool: Intelligence + Magic + Air dots + Bright dots (cap at lowest)
combos.effect: Radiant-charged wind fills the zone and creates a bonus die pool for ranged attacks. Living targets in the zone draw from this pool when making ranged attacks, adding those dice to their roll. The pool starts with dice equal to cast successes. On upkeep phases where 3 or more mana is spent on upkeep, roll the bonus mana spent and add the successes to the pool. Shade Magic dispels it.

combos.name: Sanctified Water
combos.text: Water infused with radiant energy, purifying to the living and lethal to the dead.
combos.dice_pool: Dexterity + Magic + Water dots + Bright dots (cap at lowest) for attack mode, Intelligence in place of Dexterity for utility mode
combos.effect: Declare attack or utility mode before casting. Attack mode: deals radiant water damage; doubles successes against undead. Utility mode: the zone is flooded with sanctified water, cleansing one condition per turn from living targets who remain in it and dealing damage to undead who enter or remain. Shade Magic dispels utility mode.

combos.name: Shadowflame
combos.text: Fire that burns dark. In attack form it simply destroys. In condition form it feeds.
combos.dice_pool: Dexterity + Magic + Fire dots + Shade dots (cap at lowest)
combos.effect: Declare attack or condition mode before casting. Attack mode: deals damage to a target. Condition mode: applies a persistent Shadowflame burn that drains mana from the target's pool each Upkeep Phase equal to the original cast successes, directly from the mana pool without the mana being spent. Bright Magic applied to the target or the target spending their action extinguishes the condition.

combos.name: Spore Cloud
combos.text: A thick organic cloud that gets into everything and makes every movement a struggle.
combos.dice_pool: Intelligence + Magic + Air dots + Nature dots (cap at lowest)
combos.effect: A cloud of organic spores is dispersed across the zone. Living targets in the zone must roll Fortitude + Endurance vs cast successes each Upkeep Phase. Failure applies a die penalty to all rolls equal to excess successes, lasting until the target has an Upkeep Phase outside the zone. Fire Magic ignites and dispels the cloud.

combos.name: Tempest
combos.text: A concentrated storm that bucks and tosses everything caught inside it.
combos.dice_pool: Intelligence + Magic + Water dots + Air dots (cap at lowest)
combos.effect: A localized storm of wind and rain fills the zone. Ranged attacks and targeted spells into or out of the zone suffer a die penalty equal to cast successes. Targets in the zone must roll Strength + Athletics vs cast successes each Upkeep Phase or be pushed 1 zone in a direction the caster chooses.

combos.name: Venom
combos.text: Dark fluid that poisons the living and paradoxically purges conditions from the dead.
combos.dice_pool: Dexterity + Magic + Water dots + Shade dots (cap at lowest)
combos.effect: Launches a bolt of corrupted fluid. On a hit, living targets gain the Poisoned condition with a damage value equal to cast successes. The Poison also drains mana from the target's pool each Upkeep Phase equal to the current damage value. Excess attack successes reduce the mana drain amount (to a minimum of 0) rather than adding to the Poison damage. Undead targets hit have one active condition removed instead. Bright Magic or Cleanse ends the condition.

combos.name: Ashfall
combos.text: Burning debris falls continuously, choking the zone with heat, ash, and dark energy.
combos.dice_pool: Intelligence + Magic + lowest dots among combined schools
combos.effect: Dark burning cinders rain down across the zone. All targets in the zone suffer a visibility penalty equal to cast successes on ranged attacks and targeted spells. Living targets must roll Fortitude + Endurance each Upkeep Phase or lose mana equal to half the cast successes (rounded up). Undead targets in the zone gain a bonus dice pool equal to cast successes on attack rolls. Bright Magic dispels it.

combos.name: Balance
combos.text: Life energy drawn from both light and dark holds a target in perfect, fragile equilibrium.
combos.dice_pool: Intelligence + Magic + lowest dots among combined schools
combos.effect: All conditions on the target, positive and negative alike, are suspended for a number of turns equal to cast successes. During this window the target cannot gain new conditions and all existing ones are inert. When the duration ends all suspended conditions resume simultaneously in their original state. Affects living and undead targets equally.

combos.name: Black Fog
combos.text: Hot poisonous fog that clogs lungs, drains energy, and aids the dead.
combos.dice_pool: Intelligence + Magic + lowest dots among combined schools
combos.effect: A toxic heated mist fills the zone. All targets suffer a visibility penalty equal to cast successes. Living targets must roll Fortitude + Endurance each Upkeep Phase or become Exhausted and lose mana equal to excess successes directly from their pool. Undead targets in the zone gain a bonus dice pool equal to cast successes. Exhausted lasts until the target has an Upkeep Phase outside the zone. Water Magic dispels it.

combos.name: Choking Ash
combos.text: Grit and dark energy combine into an airborne assault that chokes and drains.
combos.dice_pool: Intelligence + Magic + lowest dots among combined schools
combos.effect: Suffocating dark mineral debris fills the zone. All targets suffer a visibility penalty equal to cast successes. Living targets must roll Fortitude + Endurance each Upkeep Phase or become Exhausted and lose mana equal to excess successes. Undead targets gain a bonus dice pool equal to cast successes. Water Magic dispels it.

combos.name: Cinders
combos.text: The ground itself smolders with dark fire, burning mana and flesh together.
combos.dice_pool: Intelligence + Magic + lowest dots among combined schools
combos.effect: Corrupted smoldering earth covers the zone. Living targets in the zone must roll Fortitude + Endurance each Upkeep Phase or lose mana equal to excess successes AND take damage equal to the cast successes. Undead targets in the zone gain a bonus dice pool equal to cast successes. Water Magic applied to the zone reduces the cast successes by the Water caster's successes.

combos.name: Cleansing Gale
combos.text: A wind that strips away ailments from the living and punishes the dead for breathing.
combos.dice_pool: Intelligence + Magic + lowest dots among combined schools
combos.effect: A radiant windstorm fills the zone. Living allies in the zone have one condition removed per turn they remain. Living enemies in the zone must roll Fortitude + Endurance vs cast successes each Upkeep Phase or gain the Exhausted condition. Any undead target (ally or enemy) in the zone must roll the same or gain Exhausted with an additional 2-die penalty to all rolls for the duration. Exhausted lasts until target has Upkeep Phase outside the zone.

combos.name: Convergent Flame
combos.text: A fire that burns everything equally, indifferent to what it touches.
combos.dice_pool: Attribute + Magic + lowest dots among combined schools
combos.effect: Fire balanced between radiant and dark energies deals damage to both living and undead equally. Neither living nor undead receives resistance to this damage. Carries Armor Pen: caster may declare additional mana toward Armor Pen before rolling; every 2 mana reduces armor portion of target's DT by 1 for this attack. Armor Pen declared separately from attack and damage dice.

combos.name: Cursed Bog
combos.text: A bog of dark water that saps living strength and sustains the dead.
combos.dice_pool: Intelligence + Magic + lowest dots among combined schools
combos.effect: Corrupted waterlogged terrain fills the zone. Living targets must roll Fortitude + Endurance vs cast successes each Upkeep Phase or become Exhausted and lose mana equal to excess successes directly from their pool. Targets attempting to move in the zone roll Strength + Athletics vs cast successes or become Rooted until their next Upkeep Phase. Undead targets in the zone gain a bonus dice pool equal to cast successes. Bright Magic dispels it.

combos.name: Cursed Roots
combos.text: Dark roots that hold on and feed on whatever they catch.
combos.dice_pool: Intelligence + Magic + lowest dots among combined schools
combos.effect: Corrupted root growth erupts across the zone. The zone has a Vitality pool equal to double the cast successes. Targets entering the zone roll Dexterity + Dodge vs cast successes or become Rooted. Rooted living targets must roll Fortitude + Endurance each Upkeep Phase or lose mana equal to excess successes. Undead targets in the zone gain a bonus dice pool equal to cast successes. Fire Magic reduces the Vitality pool by the Fire caster's successes.

combos.name: Decrease Weight
combos.text: Air carries the target. Bright and Shade open a gap in the way weight applies to them. They are not floating. They are simply much less here than they were.
combos.range: Targeted (object or creature in line of sight)
combos.dice_pool: Intelligence + Magic + lowest dots among combined schools
combos.effect: The caster halves the effective weight of a single target, object, or creature. For creatures, this halves their weight for all purposes: movement costs 1 fewer AP per zone (minimum 1), Athletics rolls involving lifting or jumping gain bonus dice equal to cast successes, and falling damage is halved. For objects, the effect works as above. On 3+ successes, the caster may reduce the target's weight to one-quarter instead of one-half. At one-quarter weight, the target floats if exposed to any significant updraft or wind effect. Countdown: lasts turns equal to half the mana spent, rounded up. Paying the upkeep during the Upkeep Phase freezes the countdown for that turn. Resist: Fortitude + Endurance.

combos.name: Forge Light
combos.text: A weapon of blazing radiant metal that exists only because it was willed into existence.
combos.dice_pool: Intelligence + Magic + lowest dots among combined schools
combos.effect: Conjures a weapon of radiant forged light in the caster's zone. The weapon has both the Burning and Radiant properties and a base damage rating equal to cast successes. On upcast, the caster may spend 2 mana per additional weapon property at the time of casting. The weapon can be picked up and used by any character in the caster's zone but cannot be conjured directly into an ally's hands. If the weapon is not picked up it persists as a hazard in the zone.

combos.name: Glass Shards
combos.text: Sand fused into glass in mid-air and launched as a spray of cutting shards.
combos.dice_pool: Attribute + Magic + lowest dots among combined schools
combos.effect: Superheated sand fuses into razor fragments and launches in a cone from the caster. The caster rolls once and applies the same attack successes to all targets in the cone. Each target defends separately. Targets hit gain the Bleeding condition. Can hit allies.

combos.name: Hallowed Mire
combos.text: Holy water pressed into the ground, nourishing the living and weakening the dead.
combos.dice_pool: Intelligence + Magic + lowest dots among combined schools
combos.effect: Sanctified waterlogged terrain fills the zone. Living allies in the zone have one condition removed per turn and gain a bonus dice pool equal to cast successes. Living enemies in the zone must roll Fortitude + Endurance vs cast successes each Upkeep Phase or gain Exhausted. Any undead target (ally or enemy) in the zone must roll the same or gain Exhausted with an additional 2-die penalty to all rolls. Shade Magic dispels it.

combos.name: Healing Grove
combos.text: A grove of radiant living plants that mends allies and punishes the dead.
combos.dice_pool: Intelligence + Magic + lowest dots among combined schools
combos.effect: Radiant plant growth fills a 2x2 zone area. Each Upkeep Phase, living allies in any of the covered zones are given a PHP (Pool of Healing Points) equal to the cast successes. Healing tier: Advanced. The pool lasts until the end of that target's next turn, and any unused points are lost. Living enemies in the zone must roll Fortitude + Endurance vs cast successes each Upkeep Phase or gain Exhausted. Undead targets (ally or enemy) in the zone must roll the same or gain Exhausted with an additional 2-die penalty. Shade Magic dispels it.

combos.name: Hot Sap Spitting Plant
combos.text: A tough organic entity that spits scalding sap on command.
combos.dice_pool: Intelligence + Magic + lowest dots among combined schools
combos.effect: A plant entity erupts in an adjacent zone. It cannot act on the turn it is summoned. On subsequent turns the caster may command it to make one heated sap attack using the caster's dice pool. The attack applies the Burning condition on a hit. The plant has a Vitality pool equal to the cast successes. Earth Magic reduces the Vitality pool by the Earth caster's successes. When Vitality reaches 0 the plant is destroyed. Upkeep paid by caster.

combos.name: Increase Weight
