combos.text: Earth locks into the target. Bright and Shade balance the effect into a sustained field. Everything the target does takes more effort than it should.
combos.range: Targeted (object or creature in line of sight)
combos.dice_pool: Intelligence + Magic + lowest dots among combined schools
combos.effect: The caster doubles the effective weight of a single target, object, or creature. For creatures, this doubles their weight for all purposes: movement costs 1 additional AP per zone, Athletics rolls involving lifting or jumping lose dice equal to cast successes, and any effect that depends on or interacts with weight (including Decrease Weight) applies to the doubled value. For objects, the effect works as above. The maximum target is any single creature or object in line of sight. On 3+ successes, the caster may choose to quadruple the weight instead of doubling it. Countdown: lasts turns equal to half the mana spent, rounded up. Paying the upkeep during the Upkeep Phase freezes the countdown for that turn. Resist: Fortitude + Endurance.

combos.name: Lava
combos.text: Root channels crack open under the heat of molten earth.
combos.dice_pool: Intelligence + Magic + lowest dots among combined schools
combos.effect: Molten rock is forced upward through living root systems and covers the zone. Difficult terrain: all movement into or through the zone costs 2 additional AP. Any target entering or remaining in the zone must roll Fortitude + Endurance vs cast successes each Upkeep Phase. Failure deals damage equal to excess successes and applies the Burning condition. Water Magic applied to the zone reduces cast successes by the Water caster's successes.

combos.name: Living Rain
combos.text: A rain that carries seeds and spores. By the second turn, the ground is already growing.
combos.dice_pool: Intelligence + Magic + lowest dots among combined schools
combos.effect: First turn of existence: visibility penalty equal to cast successes on all ranged attacks and targeted spells in or out of the zone. Second turn onward: rapid plant growth also takes root in the zone. Targets entering or already in the zone must roll Dexterity + Dodge vs cast successes each Upkeep Phase or become Rooted. Earth Magic reduces cast successes by the Earth caster's successes; if reduced to 0 the spell is dispelled.

combos.name: Miasma Bloom
combos.text: Spores that rot from the inside out, poisoning and draining in the same breath.
combos.dice_pool: Intelligence + Magic + lowest dots among combined schools
combos.effect: Corrupted organic spores fill the zone. Living targets in the zone must roll Fortitude + Endurance each Upkeep Phase. On a failure they gain the Poisoned condition and lose mana equal to the cast successes directly from their pool. On a success they still lose mana equal to the successes minus their Fortitude + Endurance successes, to a minimum of 0. Undead targets in the zone gain a bonus dice pool equal to cast successes. Fire Magic ignites and dispels the cloud.

combos.name: Phoenix Bloom
combos.text: A creature of living fire and radiant energy that exists to fight or mend.
combos.dice_pool: Intelligence + Magic + lowest dots among combined schools
combos.effect: Summons a phoenix-like conjuration of radiant fire. It appears in any unoccupied zone and cannot act on the turn it is summoned. On subsequent turns the caster may command it to attack or heal. Attack command: it fires from its current zone using the caster's dice pool. Heal command: it must occupy the same zone as the target, and the target is given a PHP (Pool of Healing Points) equal to the cast successes. Healing tier: Basic. The pool lasts until the end of the target's next turn, and any unused points are lost. The conjuration has a Vitality pool equal to cast successes. Water Magic reduces the Vitality pool by the Water caster's successes.

combos.name: Plague Marsh
combos.text: Stagnant corrupt water choked with diseased growth.
combos.dice_pool: Intelligence + Magic + lowest dots among combined schools
combos.effect: Festering corrupted plant-choked water fills the zone. Living targets in the zone must roll Fortitude + Endurance each Upkeep Phase. On a failure they gain the Poisoned condition and lose mana equal to cast successes from their pool. On a success they still lose mana equal to the cast successes minus their roll successes, to a minimum of 0. Undead targets in the zone gain a bonus dice pool equal to cast successes. Bright Magic dispels it.

combos.name: Poison Fog
combos.text: Cold poisonous mist. Kills slowly. Feeds the dead.
combos.dice_pool: Intelligence + Magic + lowest dots among combined schools
combos.effect: A cold toxic mist fills the zone. Visibility penalty equal to cast successes on all ranged attacks and targeted spells. Living targets must roll Fortitude + Endurance each Upkeep Phase or gain the Poisoned condition and lose mana equal to cast successes. On a success they still lose mana equal to cast successes minus roll successes, to a minimum of 0. Undead targets in the zone gain a bonus dice pool equal to cast successes. Bright Magic dispels it.

combos.name: Quagmire Storm
combos.text: A concentrated burst of wet earth launched with enough force to displace and disorient.
combos.dice_pool: Attribute + Magic + lowest dots among combined schools
combos.effect: A targeted blast of storm-driven mud hits a single target. On a hit the target is pushed 1 zone in a direction the caster chooses and gains the Blind (Targeted) condition. Blind (Targeted) lasts until the target spends an action to clear their vision; they may still move while Blind.

combos.name: Radiant Dust
combos.text: Sparkling mineral dust that blinds enemies while guiding allies.
combos.dice_pool: Intelligence + Magic + lowest dots among combined schools
combos.effect: A shimmering cloud of illuminated mineral particles fills the zone. Living enemies in the zone who fail a Fortitude + Endurance roll vs cast successes each Upkeep Phase gain the Blind (Zone) condition, which lasts until they have an Upkeep Phase outside the zone. Living allies in the zone gain a bonus dice pool equal to cast successes. Shade Magic dispels it.

combos.name: Sacred Grove
combos.text: A space where living things are strengthened by the earth and light together.
combos.dice_pool: Intelligence + Magic + lowest dots among combined schools
combos.effect: Sanctified earth and plant growth fill the zone. Living allies in the zone gain bonus dice equal to cast successes on all rolls and have one condition removed per turn they remain. Living enemies in the zone must roll Fortitude + Endurance vs cast successes each Upkeep Phase or gain Exhausted. Undead targets (ally or enemy) must pass the same roll or gain Exhausted with a 2-die penalty to all rolls. Shade Magic dispels it.

combos.name: Sacred Steam
combos.text: Radiant steam that burns conditions away from allies and forces undead out.
combos.dice_pool: Intelligence + Magic + lowest dots among combined schools
combos.effect: Purifying steam infused with radiant energy fills the zone. Living allies in the zone have one condition removed per turn they remain. Living enemies in the zone must roll Fortitude + Endurance vs cast successes each Upkeep Phase or gain Exhausted. Undead targets (ally or enemy) in the zone must pass the same roll or gain Exhausted with a 2-die penalty. The steam cannot be extinguished by Fire Magic; Shade Magic dispels it.

combos.name: Solar Flare
combos.text: A blast of pure radiant fire that blinds everyone and burns undead twice over.
combos.dice_pool: Attribute + Magic + lowest dots among combined schools
combos.effect: A blinding burst of radiant light in a cone. The caster rolls once and applies the same attack successes to all targets. Each target defends separately. All targets hit gain the Blind (Targeted) condition. Undead targets hit take damage equal to cast successes doubled in addition to the Blind condition. Shade Magic reduces cast successes by the Shade caster's successes.

combos.name: Spore Blast
combos.text: Dandelion-like spores that drift to their destination before detonating.
combos.dice_pool: Attribute + Magic + lowest dots among combined schools
combos.effect: Floating spores drift to a 2x2 zone area and detonate on arrival. The caster rolls once and applies the same attack successes to all targets in the affected zones. Each target defends separately. The explosion is instantaneous with no persistent terrain effect. Can hit allies. The caster may choose any adjacent 2x2 zone area within their cast range.

combos.name: Spore Light
combos.text: Glowing spores that mend allies and disorient everyone else.
combos.dice_pool: Intelligence + Magic + lowest dots among combined schools
combos.effect: Luminescent spores fill the zone. Each Upkeep Phase, living allies in the zone are given a PHP (Pool of Healing Points) equal to the cast successes. Healing tier: Basic. The pool lasts until the end of that target's next turn, and any unused points are lost. Living enemies in the zone must roll Fortitude + Endurance vs cast successes each Upkeep Phase or gain a 2-die penalty to all rolls until they have an Upkeep Phase outside the zone. Undead targets in the zone must pass the same roll or gain Exhausted. Shade Magic dispels it.

combos.name: Swamp
combos.text: A zone made nearly impassable by water and growth working together.
combos.dice_pool: Intelligence + Magic + lowest dots among combined schools
combos.effect: Dense waterlogged terrain choked with plant growth fills the zone. Movement into or through the zone costs 3 additional AP. Targets entering the zone roll Strength + Athletics vs cast successes or become Rooted. Rooted targets who attempt to move roll Strength + Athletics against cast successes; failure keeps them Rooted. Fire Magic reduces cast successes by the Fire caster's successes.

combos.name: Tempest Inferno
combos.text: A superheated storm that scalds, blinds, and scatters.
combos.dice_pool: Intelligence + Magic + lowest dots among combined schools
combos.effect: A superheated hurricane of steam fills the zone. Visibility penalty equal to cast successes on all ranged attacks and targeted spells. Targets in the zone must roll Fortitude + Endurance vs cast successes each Upkeep Phase. Failure deals damage equal to excess successes and pushes the target 1 zone in a direction the caster chooses. Earth Magic reduces cast successes by the Earth caster's successes.

combos.name: Tidal Convergence
combos.text: A tidal force drawn from opposing energies that moves everything in its path.
combos.dice_pool: Attribute + Magic + lowest dots among combined schools
combos.effect: A wave of balanced opposing energies crashes through a zone. The caster rolls once and applies the same attack successes to all targets in the zone, living and undead alike. Neither type receives resistance to this damage. All targets hit, whether damaged or not, are pushed 1 zone away from the caster. The caster chooses the direction.

combos.name: Vines of Rotfire
combos.text: Burning dark vines that hold on and feed off the living, but free the dead.
combos.dice_pool: Attribute + Magic + lowest dots among combined schools
combos.effect: Dark flaming vines erupt from the ground and seize a living target, applying the Rooted condition. Each Upkeep Phase the target remains Rooted they take damage equal to the original attack successes and lose mana equal to half the successes (rounded up). Undead targets hit instead have one active condition removed and gain a bonus dice pool equal to cast successes until they leave the zone. Bright Magic dispels the vines. Target may attempt to break free by rolling Strength + Athletics vs original cast successes during their Upkeep Phase.

combos.name: Volcanic Spring
combos.text: The ground beneath the zone cracks open with scalding eruptions.
combos.dice_pool: Intelligence + Magic + lowest dots among combined schools
combos.effect: Superheated water is forced through cracked earth, erupting as scalding geysers across the zone. Each Upkeep Phase the zone is active, targets inside must roll Dexterity + Dodge vs cast successes or be struck by a geyser and take damage equal to excess successes plus the Burning condition. Difficult terrain: movement into or through the zone costs 1 additional AP. Nature Magic reduces cast successes by the Nature caster's successes.

combos.name: Wooden Wall
combos.text: Dense timber that did not grow here but exists regardless.
combos.dice_pool: Intelligence + Magic + lowest dots among combined schools
combos.effect: Dense conjured timber forms a wall along a border between two zones. The wall blocks movement across that border entirely until destroyed. The wall has a Vitality pool equal to double the cast successes. Fire spells reduce the Vitality pool by the Fire caster's successes. Melee attacks with bladed weapons reduce it by damage successes. This is a physical barrier, not an elemental wall; elemental advantage rules do not apply to it.

combos.name: Ashen Waste
combos.text: Nothing grows here now, and the dead like it that way.
combos.range: AoE-4 (2x2 zone area), any zone within line of sight
combos.dice_pool: Intelligence + Magic + lowest dots among combined schools
combos.effect: The area is scorched and blighted. Every Nature Magic terrain effect in the area ends when the spell is cast. Each Upkeep Phase, living targets in the area must roll Fortitude + Endurance vs cast successes or take damage equal to excess successes and gain the Poisoned condition. Undead in the area gain bonus dice equal to cast successes on all rolls. Countdown: lasts turns equal to half the mana spent, rounded up. Paying the upkeep during the Upkeep Phase freezes the countdown for that turn.

combos.name: Black Blizzard
combos.text: A winter that eats warmth and mana alike.
combos.range: AoE-4 (2x2 zone area), any zone within line of sight
combos.dice_pool: Intelligence + Magic + lowest dots among combined schools
combos.effect: A freezing storm of dark snow fills the area. All ranged attacks and targeted spells into or out of the area lose dice equal to cast successes. Each Upkeep Phase, living targets in the area must roll Fortitude + Endurance vs cast successes or gain the Chilled condition and lose mana equal to half the cast successes (rounded up). Undead in the area gain bonus dice equal to cast successes on attack rolls. Countdown: lasts turns equal to half the mana spent, rounded up. Paying the upkeep during the Upkeep Phase freezes the countdown for that turn.

combos.name: Black Lightning
combos.text: Lightning that strikes the body and the soul's reserves at once.
combos.dice_pool: Dexterity + Magic + lowest dots among combined schools
combos.effect: A bolt of dark lightning strikes a target. On a hit the target takes damage equal to excess successes. Living targets also lose mana equal to the excess successes, and cannot use Reactions until the start of their next turn. Defend: Dexterity + Dodge.

combos.name: Blessed Downpour
combos.text: Rain that carries life to everyone it touches.
combos.range: AoE-9 (3x3 zone area), any zone within line of sight
combos.dice_pool: Intelligence + Magic + lowest dots among combined schools
combos.effect: A soft radiant rain falls across a wide area. Each Upkeep Phase, every living ally in the area is given a PHP (Pool of Healing Points) equal to the cast successes. Healing tier: Advanced. The pool lasts until the end of the target's next turn, and any unused points are lost. Undead in the area gain the Chilled condition each Upkeep Phase. Countdown: lasts turns equal to half the mana spent, rounded up. Paying the upkeep during the Upkeep Phase freezes the countdown for that turn.

combos.name: Bog Revenant
combos.text: The bog gives back what it took, and none of it is friendly.
combos.dice_pool: Intelligence + Magic + lowest dots among combined schools
combos.effect: Mud, bone, and dead roots rise from the ground as a mindless undead conjuration. It cannot act on the turn it is summoned. On later turns the caster may command it to attack a target in an adjacent zone using the caster's dice pool. A target hit by it takes damage equal to excess successes and must roll Strength + Athletics vs cast successes or become Rooted. It has a Vitality pool equal to triple the cast successes. Bright Magic attacks against it deal double damage. Countdown: lasts turns equal to half the mana spent, rounded up. Paying the upkeep during the Upkeep Phase freezes the countdown for that turn.

combos.name: Caustic Bloom
combos.text: Lye and rot, flung hard enough to stick.
combos.dice_pool: Dexterity + Magic + lowest dots among combined schools
combos.effect: A burst of corrosive, rotting sap strikes a target. On a hit the target takes damage equal to excess successes and gains the Poisoned condition with a value equal to the cast successes. The armor portion of the target's DT is reduced by the cast successes until the end of the scene as the sap eats through it. Defend: Dexterity + Dodge.

combos.name: Chain of Heaven
combos.text: It knows exactly who it is looking for.
combos.dice_pool: Dexterity + Magic + lowest dots among combined schools
combos.effect: Radiant lightning strikes a target, then leaps to additional enemies. After the first target, the lightning jumps to up to the caster's Bright dots in additional targets, each in a zone adjacent to the last target hit. Each target defends separately against the same attack successes. Targets hit take damage equal to excess successes. Undead targets take double damage. The lightning will not jump to the caster's allies. Defend: Dexterity + Dodge.

combos.name: Crucible Bind
combos.text: Heat to soften, weight to hold, and two opposite forces to seal it shut.
combos.dice_pool: Dexterity + Magic + lowest dots among combined schools
combos.effect: A ring of molten stone held by crushing force closes around a single target, living or undead. On a hit the target becomes Rooted and takes damage equal to excess successes. Each Upkeep Phase the target remains Rooted they take damage equal to the cast successes. The target may roll Strength + Athletics vs cast successes during their Upkeep Phase to break free, which ends the spell. Countdown: lasts turns equal to half the mana spent, rounded up. Paying the upkeep during the Upkeep Phase freezes the countdown for that turn. Defend: Dexterity + Dodge.

combos.name: Crystal Sanctuary
combos.text: A shelter that light passes through and very little else.
combos.dice_pool: Intelligence + Magic + lowest dots among combined schools
combos.effect: A shining dome of crystal and water forms over the zone. Ranged attacks and targeted spells from outside the dome against anyone inside lose dice equal to the cast successes. Undead cannot enter the dome unless they succeed on Fortitude + Endurance vs cast successes. Allies inside gain bonus dice equal to half the cast successes (rounded up) on resistance rolls. The dome has a Vitality pool equal to triple the cast successes; Shade Magic attacks against it deal double damage. Countdown: lasts turns equal to half the mana spent, rounded up. Paying the upkeep during the Upkeep Phase freezes the countdown for that turn.

combos.name: Drowning Mire
combos.text: It pulls you down, and it does not let go.
combos.range: AoE-4 (2x2 zone area), any zone within line of sight
combos.dice_pool: Intelligence + Magic + lowest dots among combined schools
combos.effect: The ground in the area becomes a dark, sucking bog. Any target entering or starting their turn in the area must roll Strength + Athletics vs cast successes or become Rooted. Each Upkeep Phase, living targets in the area must roll Fortitude + Endurance vs cast successes or take damage equal to excess successes and lose the same amount of mana. Undead move through the area freely. Countdown: lasts turns equal to half the mana spent, rounded up. Paying the upkeep during the Upkeep Phase freezes the countdown for that turn.

combos.name: Ember Rain
combos.text: Rain that feels like a hearth after a long night.
combos.range: AoE-4 (2x2 zone area), any zone within line of sight
combos.dice_pool: Intelligence + Magic + lowest dots among combined schools
combos.effect: Warm glowing rain falls over the area. Each Upkeep Phase, every living ally in the area is given a PHP (Pool of Healing Points) equal to the cast successes. Healing tier: Advanced. The pool lasts until the end of the target's next turn, and any unused points are lost. When the rain first falls, every living ally in the area also has one Burning, Chilled, or Poisoned condition removed. Undead in the area gain the Burning condition each Upkeep Phase. Countdown: lasts turns equal to half the mana spent, rounded up. Paying the upkeep during the Upkeep Phase freezes the countdown for that turn.

combos.name: Fulgurite Strike
combos.text: Where the lightning ran, the ground turned to glass.
combos.dice_pool: Dexterity + Magic + lowest dots among combined schools
combos.effect: A bolt of lightning tears across the ground in a straight line, fusing the earth into glass behind it. Every target in the line defends separately. Targets hit take damage equal to excess successes and gain the Burning condition. Every zone in the line becomes difficult terrain from the glassed ground. Defend: Dexterity + Dodge.

combos.name: Full Gravity
combos.text: Bright and Shade together can regulate fundamental forces when guided by Earth and Air. What they can do to weight in either direction is a matter of how many successes the caster can bring to it.
combos.range: Targeted (object or creature in line of sight)
combos.dice_pool: Intelligence + Magic + lowest dots among combined schools
combos.effect: The caster takes complete control of a target's relationship to gravity, increasing or decreasing it in either direction by factors. The caster chooses direction and intensity at cast time. Each success on the roll increases the factor by 1 in either direction. At 1 success: weight is halved or doubled. At 3 successes: weight is quartered or quadrupled. At 5 successes: target is weightless (floats freely without wind) or crushed (takes 1 damage each Upkeep Phase from compression and cannot move on their own). At 7+ successes: the target can be projected upward as if launched (weightless + upward velocity) or collapsed inward under extreme gravity (Pinned condition, 2 damage each Upkeep Phase). Countdown: lasts turns equal to half the mana spent, rounded up. Paying the upkeep during the Upkeep Phase freezes the countdown for that turn. Resist: Fortitude + Endurance. Increasing successes in the crushing direction requires re-rolling each turn at the same cost.

combos.name: Hearthroot
combos.text: Sit by this fire and the worst of it mends.
combos.dice_pool: Intelligence + Magic + lowest dots among combined schools
combos.effect: A warm stone hearth wrapped in glowing roots rises in the zone. Each Upkeep Phase, every living ally in the zone is given a PHP (Pool of Healing Points) equal to the cast successes. Healing tier: Expert. The pool lasts until the end of the target's next turn, and any unused points are lost. Undead in the zone gain the Burning condition each Upkeep Phase. The hearth has a Vitality pool equal to double the cast successes; if it is destroyed the spell ends. Countdown: lasts turns equal to half the mana spent, rounded up. Paying the upkeep during the Upkeep Phase freezes the countdown for that turn.

combos.name: Kiln Storm
combos.text: Four elements melt, fire, and shatter into a single scouring storm.
combos.range: AoE-4 (2x2 zone area), any zone within line of sight
combos.dice_pool: Dexterity + Magic + lowest dots among combined schools
combos.effect: A storm of superheated glass and fired clay shards tears through the area. Caster rolls once and every target in the area defends separately. Targets hit take damage equal to excess successes and gain both the Burning and Bleeding conditions. All zones in the area become difficult terrain from the broken shards. Defend: Dexterity + Dodge.

combos.name: Kilnborn Guardian
combos.text: Clay fired in the moment, held together by roots that refuse to let go.
combos.dice_pool: Intelligence + Magic + lowest dots among combined schools
combos.effect: The caster shapes fired clay bound with living roots into a guardian. It cannot act on the turn it is summoned. On later turns the caster may command it to attack a target in an adjacent zone using the caster's dice pool, or to guard an ally in its zone, adding the cast successes to that ally's BDT until the guardian's next action. The guardian has a Vitality pool equal to triple the cast successes. Water Magic reduces its Vitality by the Water caster's successes. Countdown: lasts turns equal to half the mana spent, rounded up. Paying the upkeep during the Upkeep Phase freezes the countdown for that turn.

combos.name: Mirror Mist
combos.text: You see them. You see them again. You see them everywhere.
combos.dice_pool: Intelligence + Magic + lowest dots among combined schools
combos.effect: A mist of reflecting light and shadow fills the zone, filling it with images of everyone inside. Any attack or targeted spell against a target in the zone requires the attacker to first roll Perception + Awareness vs cast successes. On a failure the attack strikes a reflection and misses. Countdown: lasts turns equal to half the mana spent, rounded up. Paying the upkeep during the Upkeep Phase freezes the countdown for that turn.

combos.name: Monsoon
combos.text: The rains come, and the land answers by growing.
combos.range: AoE-9 (3x3 zone area), any zone within line of sight
combos.dice_pool: Intelligence + Magic + lowest dots among combined schools
combos.effect: Torrential rain floods the area. The area is difficult terrain. All ranged attacks and targeted spells into or out of the area lose dice equal to half the cast successes (rounded up). Plants surge up through the mud: each Upkeep Phase, every target in the area must roll Strength + Athletics vs cast successes or become Rooted until their next Upkeep Phase. Fire Magic effects in the area lose successes equal to the cast successes each Upkeep Phase. Countdown: lasts turns equal to half the mana spent, rounded up. Paying the upkeep during the Upkeep Phase freezes the countdown for that turn.

combos.name: Obsidian Storm
combos.text: Black glass that cuts and keeps cutting.
combos.range: AoE-4 (2x2 zone area), any zone within line of sight
combos.dice_pool: Dexterity + Magic + lowest dots among combined schools
combos.effect: A whirlwind of black volcanic glass shreds the area. Caster rolls once and every target in the area defends separately. Targets hit take damage equal to excess successes and gain the Bleeding condition. Living targets hit also lose mana equal to their excess successes taken. Defend: Dexterity + Dodge.

combos.name: Petrify
combos.text: Life held still, neither living nor dead, until it is let go.
combos.dice_pool: Intelligence + Magic + lowest dots among combined schools
combos.effect: Stone and wood creep over a single target and lock them in place. The target must roll Fortitude + Endurance vs cast successes. On a failure the target gains the Petrified condition. During each Upkeep Phase they may roll Strength + Athletics vs cast successes to break free. Bright or Shade Magic that meets or exceeds the cast successes ends it early. Countdown: lasts turns equal to half the mana spent, rounded up. Paying the upkeep during the Upkeep Phase freezes the countdown for that turn. Resist: Fortitude + Endurance.

combos.name: Plague Fog
combos.text: A sickness with somewhere to be.
combos.range: AoE-4 (2x2 zone area), any zone within line of sight
combos.dice_pool: Intelligence + Magic + lowest dots among combined schools
combos.effect: A sickly green fog fills the area and drifts. During each Upkeep Phase the caster may move the whole fog 1 zone in any direction. Each Upkeep Phase, living targets in the fog must roll Fortitude + Endurance vs cast successes or gain the Poisoned condition with a value equal to the cast successes and lose mana equal to half the cast successes (rounded up). Air Magic reduces the cast successes by the Air caster's successes. Countdown: lasts turns equal to half the mana spent, rounded up. Paying the upkeep during the Upkeep Phase freezes the countdown for that turn.

combos.name: Pressure of the Deep
combos.text: The whole sea, pressing on one person.
combos.dice_pool: Intelligence + Magic + lowest dots among combined schools
combos.effect: The crushing weight of the deep ocean settles on a single target. While the spell lasts, the target's movement costs 1 additional AP per zone and all of their rolls lose dice equal to half the cast successes (rounded up). Each Upkeep Phase the target takes damage equal to the cast successes unless they succeed on Fortitude + Endurance vs cast successes. Countdown: lasts turns equal to half the mana spent, rounded up. Paying the upkeep during the Upkeep Phase freezes the countdown for that turn. Resist: Fortitude + Endurance.

combos.name: Prism Storm
combos.text: Ice that catches the light and turns it into a weapon against the dead.
combos.range: AoE-9 (3x3 zone area), any zone within line of sight
combos.dice_pool: Dexterity + Magic + lowest dots among combined schools
combos.effect: A shower of glowing ice crystals falls across the area. Undead targets in the area take damage equal to excess successes and gain the Chilled condition. Living allies in the area each have one Burning or Chilled condition removed. Living enemies are unharmed but lose 1 die on ranged attacks until the start of the next Upkeep Phase from the glare. Defend: Dexterity + Dodge.

combos.name: Pyre of Balance
combos.text: What burns away feeds what remains.
combos.dice_pool: Intelligence + Magic + lowest dots among combined schools
combos.effect: A pyre of light and dark flame burns in the zone. Each Upkeep Phase, every enemy in the zone, living or undead, takes damage equal to the cast successes unless they succeed on Fortitude + Endurance vs cast successes. When any enemy in the zone becomes Incapacitated, every living ally in the zone is given a PHP (Pool of Healing Points) equal to the cast successes. Healing tier: Advanced. The pool lasts until the end of the target's next turn, and any unused points are lost. Countdown: lasts turns equal to half the mana spent, rounded up. Paying the upkeep during the Upkeep Phase freezes the countdown for that turn.

combos.name: Sacred Canopy
combos.text: Shade, but the kind made by light.
combos.range: AoE-9 (3x3 zone area) centered on the caster's zone
combos.dice_pool: Intelligence + Magic + lowest dots among combined schools
combos.effect: A great tree of light spreads its canopy over the area. Ranged attacks and targeted spells against allies under the canopy lose dice equal to the cast successes. Each Upkeep Phase, undead under the canopy must roll Fortitude + Endurance vs cast successes or gain the Exhausted condition. Countdown: lasts turns equal to half the mana spent, rounded up. Paying the upkeep during the Upkeep Phase freezes the countdown for that turn.

combos.name: Sap Siphon
combos.text: Taken from one, given to another.
combos.dice_pool: Dexterity + Magic + lowest dots among combined schools
combos.effect: A vine of light and shadow lashes a living enemy and draws their life into an ally. On a hit the target takes damage equal to excess successes. One living ally within line of sight is then given a PHP (Pool of Healing Points) equal to the excess successes. Healing tier: Advanced. The pool lasts until the end of the target's next turn, and any unused points are lost. Undead cannot be targeted by this spell. Defend: Dexterity + Dodge.

combos.name: Sunforged Armor
combos.text: Armor fired in holy light and cooled in an instant.
combos.range: Self and allies in adjacent zones, up to Bright dots in targets
combos.dice_pool: Intelligence + Magic + lowest dots among combined schools
combos.effect: Radiant glazed ceramic forms over each target like armor. Each target adds the cast successes to their BDT. Undead attacking a protected target lose dice equal to cast successes. Shade Magic that meets or exceeds the cast successes shatters the armor on one target. Countdown: lasts turns equal to half the mana spent, rounded up. Paying the upkeep during the Upkeep Phase freezes the countdown for that turn.

combos.name: Sunglass Lens
combos.text: A single point of sunlight, made unbearable.
combos.dice_pool: Dexterity + Magic + lowest dots among combined schools
combos.effect: The caster forms a lens of glass in the air and focuses radiant sunlight through it onto a single target. On a hit the target takes damage equal to excess successes doubled. On 3+ excess successes the target also gains the Blind (Targeted) condition. Undead hit by this spell also gain the Burning condition. Defend: Dexterity + Dodge.

combos.name: Tar Pit
combos.text: Hot, black, and patient.
combos.range: AoE-4 (2x2 zone area), any zone within line of sight
combos.dice_pool: Intelligence + Magic + lowest dots among combined schools
combos.effect: Black boiling pitch floods the area. The area is difficult terrain. Any target entering or starting their turn in the area must roll Strength + Athletics vs cast successes or become Rooted, and every Rooted target gains the Burning condition. Each Upkeep Phase, living targets in the area lose mana equal to half the cast successes (rounded up). Water Magic reduces the cast successes by the Water caster's successes. Countdown: lasts turns equal to half the mana spent, rounded up. Paying the upkeep during the Upkeep Phase freezes the countdown for that turn.

combos.name: Teleportation
combos.text: One step here, the next step somewhere else entirely.
combos.range: Self and willing allies in adjacent zones
combos.dice_pool: Intelligence + Magic + lowest dots among combined schools
combos.effect: The caster folds the space between two points and steps through it. The caster and up to the cast successes in willing allies in their zone or adjacent zones are moved instantly to unoccupied zones of the caster's choice within line of sight. On 5+ successes the destination can instead be any place the caster has personally been and can picture clearly, at any distance. Teleportation cannot place anyone in an occupied zone. For long-distance travel between prepared points, see Teleportation in Circle Magic.

combos.name: Thornwood Maze
combos.text: Every way out is a way through thorns.
combos.range: AoE-9 (3x3 zone area), any zone within line of sight
combos.dice_pool: Intelligence + Magic + lowest dots among combined schools
combos.effect: Walls of dark, thorned wood erupt across the area, forming a maze. The caster designates which zone borders are open paths when casting. Crossing any other border inside the area requires pushing through the thorns: the target rolls Strength + Athletics vs cast successes, takes damage equal to the caster's excess successes on a failure, gains the Bleeding condition, and living targets also lose 1 mana. Countdown: lasts turns equal to half the mana spent, rounded up. Paying the upkeep during the Upkeep Phase freezes the countdown for that turn.

combos.name: Thunderstorm
combos.text: Rain to carry it, heat to spark it, air to throw it, and something living to call it down.
combos.range: AoE-4 (2x2 zone area), any zone within line of sight
combos.dice_pool: Intelligence + Magic + lowest dots among combined schools
combos.effect: Black clouds gather over the area and lightning falls through the rain. Each Upkeep Phase, every target in the area must defend against the cast successes. Targets hit take damage equal to excess successes and lose their free move for that turn from the shock. Targets wearing metal armor lose 2 dice on this defense. Countdown: lasts turns equal to half the mana spent, rounded up. Paying the upkeep during the Upkeep Phase freezes the countdown for that turn. Defend: Dexterity + Dodge.

combos.name: Twilight Steam
combos.text: In the haze between light and dark, spells forget how they were made.
combos.dice_pool: Intelligence + Magic + lowest dots among combined schools
combos.effect: A shimmering steam of light and shadow fills the zone and unravels magic. Each Upkeep Phase, every persistent spell effect in the zone (from any school, including the caster's own) loses successes equal to the cast successes, and any reduced to 0 ends. Any target casting a spell while inside the zone loses dice equal to half the cast successes (rounded up). Countdown: lasts turns equal to half the mana spent, rounded up. Paying the upkeep during the Upkeep Phase freezes the countdown for that turn.

combos.name: Twin Corona
combos.text: Two fires, opposite in every way, agreeing on one thing: keep away.
combos.dice_pool: Intelligence + Magic + lowest dots among combined schools
combos.effect: A ring of light and dark fire circles the caster. Any target that makes a melee attack against the caster takes damage equal to the cast successes, living or undead alike. Ranged attacks and targeted spells against the caster lose dice equal to half the cast successes (rounded up). Countdown: lasts turns equal to half the mana spent, rounded up. Paying the upkeep during the Upkeep Phase freezes the countdown for that turn.

combos.name: Wellspring
combos.text: The kind of water people walk for days to find.
combos.dice_pool: Intelligence + Magic + lowest dots among combined schools
combos.effect: A spring of radiant water rises around a living target and soaks into their wounds. The target is given a PHP (Pool of Healing Points) equal to the cast successes. Healing tier: Expert. The pool lingers using the countdown mechanic: it lasts turns equal to half the mana spent, rounded up, and paying the upkeep during the Upkeep Phase freezes it. Unused points are lost when it ends. When cast, the target also has one condition of their choice removed.

combos.name: Renewal
combos.text: What was lost grows back as though it had never been gone.
combos.dice_pool: Intelligence + Magic + lowest dots among combined schools
combos.effect: Can only be cast outside combat. The target is given a PHP (Pool of Healing Points) equal to the cast successes. Healing tier: Master. Each point can regrow one lost limb, eye, or organ, or neutralize 1 Aggravated damage. The pool lasts until the end of the scene, and any unused points are lost.

combos.name: Black Meteor
combos.text: The sky goes dark before it lands.
combos.range: AoE-9 (3x3 zone area), any zone within line of sight
combos.dice_pool: Dexterity + Magic + lowest dots among combined schools
combos.effect: A meteor of dark burning stone falls on the area. Caster rolls once and every target in the area defends separately. Targets hit take damage equal to excess successes and gain the Burning condition. Living targets hit also lose mana equal to the cast successes. Every zone in the area becomes Darkened until the start of the next Upkeep Phase. Defend: Dexterity + Dodge.

combos.name: Blackfire Wildwood
combos.text: A forest that burns and keeps growing anyway.
combos.dice_pool: Intelligence + Magic + lowest dots among combined schools
combos.effect: A forest of dark, burning trees erupts in a zone and spreads. During each Upkeep Phase the wood spreads into one adjacent zone of the caster's choice. Every zone of the wood is difficult terrain. Each Upkeep Phase, every living target in the wood must roll Fortitude + Endurance vs cast successes or take damage equal to excess successes and gain the Burning and Bleeding conditions. Undead move through the wood freely. Countdown: lasts turns equal to half the mana spent, rounded up. Paying the upkeep during the Upkeep Phase freezes the countdown for that turn.

combos.name: Drowned World
combos.text: The water rises, and it brings the bottom of the lake with it.
combos.range: AoE-9 (3x3 zone area), any zone within line of sight
combos.dice_pool: Intelligence + Magic + lowest dots among combined schools
combos.effect: Dark water floods the area and the ground beneath it turns to choking mire. The area is difficult terrain, and every target in it must roll Strength + Athletics vs cast successes when they try to leave a zone or become Rooted. Each Upkeep Phase, living targets in the area must roll Fortitude + Endurance vs cast successes or take damage equal to excess successes and lose the same amount of mana. Undead in the area gain bonus dice equal to the cast successes on all rolls. Countdown: lasts turns equal to half the mana spent, rounded up. Paying the upkeep during the Upkeep Phase freezes the countdown for that turn.

combos.name: Gravity Tide
combos.text: Gravity, rearranged like furniture.
combos.range: AoE-9 (3x3 zone area), any zone within line of sight
combos.dice_pool: Intelligence + Magic + lowest dots among combined schools
combos.effect: A tide of shifting weight rolls through the area. For each target in the area, the caster chooses: move them up to 2 zones in any direction, or double or halve their weight until the end of their next turn. Unwilling targets roll Strength + Athletics vs cast successes to resist being moved and Fortitude + Endurance vs cast successes to resist the weight change.

combos.name: Gravity Well
combos.text: Everything falls toward the fire.
combos.range: AoE-9 (3x3 zone area), any zone within line of sight
combos.dice_pool: Intelligence + Magic + lowest dots among combined schools
combos.effect: A collapsing point of burning force forms at the center of the area. Each Upkeep Phase, every target in the area must roll Strength + Athletics vs cast successes or be pulled 1 zone toward the center. Any target that starts its turn in the center zone takes damage equal to the cast successes and gains the Burning condition. Countdown: lasts turns equal to half the mana spent, rounded up. Paying the upkeep during the Upkeep Phase freezes the countdown for that turn.

combos.name: Lifeforge
combos.text: The forge where bodies are made whole again.
combos.range: AoE-4 (2x2 zone area), any zone within line of sight
combos.dice_pool: Intelligence + Magic + lowest dots among combined schools
combos.effect: Warm earth, flowing water, living growth, and radiant fire knit together in the area. Every living ally in the area is given a PHP (Pool of Healing Points) equal to the cast successes. Healing tier: Expert. The pool lingers using the countdown mechanic: it lasts turns equal to half the mana spent, rounded up, and paying the upkeep during the Upkeep Phase freezes it. Unused points are lost when it ends. When cast, every living ally in the area also has all conditions removed.

combos.name: Phoenix Form
combos.text: Wings of fire that burn your enemies and warm your friends.
combos.dice_pool: Intelligence + Magic + lowest dots among combined schools
combos.effect: The caster takes the form of a great bird of light and shadow fire. While active the caster can fly with the Flight specialty, their attacks apply the Burning condition on a hit, and they add the cast successes to their BDT. Each Upkeep Phase, every living ally in a zone adjacent to the caster is given a PHP (Pool of Healing Points) equal to half the cast successes (rounded up). Healing tier: Basic. The pool lasts until the end of the target's next turn, and any unused points are lost. Countdown: lasts turns equal to half the mana spent, rounded up. Paying the upkeep during the Upkeep Phase freezes the countdown for that turn.

combos.name: Plague Storm
combos.text: A storm that does not pass. It lingers and it spreads.
combos.range: AoE-9 (3x3 zone area), any zone within line of sight
combos.dice_pool: Intelligence + Magic + lowest dots among combined schools
combos.effect: A green-black storm of poisoned rain and dark lightning settles over the area. Each Upkeep Phase, every living target in the area must roll Fortitude + Endurance vs cast successes or take damage equal to excess successes, gain the Poisoned condition with a value equal to the cast successes, and lose mana equal to half the cast successes (rounded up). Countdown: lasts turns equal to half the mana spent, rounded up. Paying the upkeep during the Upkeep Phase freezes the countdown for that turn.

combos.name: Primordial Storm
combos.text: Fire, flood, wind, stone, and root, all arriving together.
combos.range: AoE-9 (3x3 zone area), any zone within line of sight
combos.dice_pool: Dexterity + Magic + lowest dots among combined schools
combos.effect: Every element of the natural world strikes the area at once. Caster rolls once and every target in the area defends separately. Targets hit take damage equal to excess successes and gain the Burning, Chilled, and Rooted conditions, and are Knocked Down. Every zone in the area becomes difficult terrain. Defend: Dexterity + Dodge.

combos.name: Reshape the Land
combos.text: The map is now a suggestion.
combos.range: AoE-9 (3x3 zone area), any zone within line of sight
combos.dice_pool: Intelligence + Magic + lowest dots among combined schools
combos.effect: The caster permanently reshapes the land in the area. They may raise or lower ground by one vertical zone, create or remove difficult terrain, raise walls of stone or wood along zone borders, grow or burn away forests, and open or close pits. The changes are physical and permanent, and do not need upkeep. Any target standing where the ground moves must roll Dexterity + Acrobatics vs cast successes or be Knocked Down and take damage equal to excess successes.

combos.name: Rotting Caldera
combos.text: Fire, rot, and steam rising from a wound in the world.
combos.range: AoE-9 (3x3 zone area), any zone within line of sight
combos.dice_pool: Intelligence + Magic + lowest dots among combined schools
combos.effect: The ground in the area cracks open into a corrupted volcanic basin. The area is difficult terrain. Each Upkeep Phase, every living target in the area must roll Fortitude + Endurance vs cast successes or take damage equal to excess successes, gain the Burning and Poisoned conditions, and lose mana equal to half the cast successes (rounded up). Undead in the area gain bonus dice equal to the cast successes on all rolls. Countdown: lasts turns equal to half the mana spent, rounded up. Paying the upkeep during the Upkeep Phase freezes the countdown for that turn.

combos.name: Sky Citadel
combos.text: A hill that decided it would rather be a cloud.
combos.range: AoE-4 (2x2 zone area), any zone within line of sight
combos.dice_pool: Intelligence + Magic + lowest dots among combined schools
combos.effect: A fortress of stone and living wood tears free of the ground and floats one vertical zone above it, held aloft by light and shadow. Allies inside or on the citadel cannot be reached by ground melee attacks, and ranged attacks and targeted spells against them lose dice equal to the cast successes. The citadel moves 1 zone in any direction during each Upkeep Phase at the caster's command. It has a Vitality pool equal to four times the cast successes. When the spell ends it settles gently to the ground. Countdown: lasts turns equal to half the mana spent, rounded up. Paying the upkeep during the Upkeep Phase freezes the countdown for that turn.

combos.name: Soul Lightning
combos.text: It takes what they had and hands it to someone better.
combos.dice_pool: Dexterity + Magic + lowest dots among combined schools
combos.effect: A bolt of lightning that strikes the spirit rather than the flesh. On a hit, the target loses mana equal to double the excess successes. Living targets also take damage equal to excess successes. The caster may give any amount of the drained mana to allies within line of sight, split as they choose, without exceeding any ally's Mana Pool cap. Defend: Dexterity + Dodge.

combos.name: Starforged Titan
combos.text: A guardian built from everything the forge can give.
combos.dice_pool: Intelligence + Magic + lowest dots among combined schools
combos.effect: The caster forges a towering construct of glowing metal and stone, balanced by light and shadow. It cannot act on the turn it is summoned. On later turns the caster may command it to make one attack against a target in an adjacent zone using the caster's dice pool, dealing damage to living and undead alike, or to stand guard, adding the cast successes to the BDT of every ally in its zone and adjacent zones until its next action. It has a Vitality pool equal to four times the cast successes and is immune to the Knocked Down and Rooted conditions. Countdown: lasts turns equal to half the mana spent, rounded up. Paying the upkeep during the Upkeep Phase freezes the countdown for that turn.

combos.name: Stormbreaker
combos.text: Where it passes, the magic of others simply comes undone.
combos.range: AoE-9 (3x3 zone area), any zone within line of sight
combos.dice_pool: Intelligence + Magic + lowest dots among combined schools
combos.effect: A storm of opposing light and shadow tears through every working of magic in the area. Every persistent spell effect in the area whose cast successes are equal to or lower than this spell's cast successes ends immediately. Effects with higher cast successes lose successes equal to this spell's cast successes. Conjurations in the area take damage equal to the cast successes.

combos.name: Sunfall
combos.text: A piece of the sun, dropped with intent.
combos.range: AoE-9 (3x3 zone area), any zone within line of sight
combos.dice_pool: Dexterity + Magic + lowest dots among combined schools
combos.effect: A radiant meteor of molten stone falls on the area. Caster rolls once and every target in the area defends separately. Targets hit take damage equal to excess successes and gain the Burning condition. Undead take double damage. Living allies in the area take no damage and instead have one condition removed. The impact zone becomes difficult terrain. Defend: Dexterity + Dodge.

combos.name: Veil Rain
combos.text: Some are hidden in it. Some cannot hide from it.
combos.range: AoE-9 (3x3 zone area), any zone within line of sight
combos.dice_pool: Intelligence + Magic + lowest dots among combined schools
combos.effect: A rain that hides and reveals falls across the area. For each target in the area the caster chooses veiled or revealed. Veiled targets cause ranged attacks and targeted spells against them to lose dice equal to the cast successes. Revealed targets cannot benefit from Stealth, darkness, or invisibility. The caster may change any target's choice during each Upkeep Phase. Countdown: lasts turns equal to half the mana spent, rounded up. Paying the upkeep during the Upkeep Phase freezes the countdown for that turn.

combos.name: Verdant Sanctuary
combos.text: A place the dead cannot reach and the living do not want to leave.
combos.range: AoE-9 (3x3 zone area) centered on the caster's zone
combos.dice_pool: Intelligence + Magic + lowest dots among combined schools
combos.effect: A living garden of light, water, and stone grows across the area. Each Upkeep Phase, every living ally in the area is given a PHP (Pool of Healing Points) equal to the cast successes. Healing tier: Advanced. The pool lasts until the end of the target's next turn, and any unused points are lost. Undead cannot enter the area unless they succeed on Fortitude + Endurance vs cast successes, and undead already inside gain the Exhausted condition. Countdown: lasts turns equal to half the mana spent, rounded up. Paying the upkeep during the Upkeep Phase freezes the countdown for that turn.

combos.name: Worldroot
combos.text: The ground itself takes a side.
combos.range: All zones within line of sight
combos.dice_pool: Intelligence + Magic + lowest dots among combined schools
combos.effect: A vast network of roots spreads beneath every zone the caster can see. During each Upkeep Phase the caster may target any one creature standing on the ground in sight: it must roll Strength + Athletics vs cast successes or become Rooted. Each Upkeep Phase, every Rooted living enemy loses mana equal to half the cast successes (rounded up), and the caster may give that mana to allies on the ground, without exceeding their Mana Pool caps. Countdown: lasts turns equal to half the mana spent, rounded up. Paying the upkeep during the Upkeep Phase freezes the countdown for that turn.

combos.name: Wrath of the Sun
combos.text: A line drawn across the world in light.
combos.range: AoE-Line, extending to the edge of line of sight
combos.dice_pool: Dexterity + Magic + lowest dots among combined schools
combos.effect: A beam of radiant lightning races across the battlefield in a straight line, glassing the ground as it goes. Every target in the line defends separately. Targets hit take damage equal to excess successes and gain the Burning condition. Undead take double damage. Every zone in the line becomes difficult terrain. Defend: Dexterity + Dodge.

combos.name: Grand Restoration
combos.text: As though none of it had ever happened.
combos.range: All zones within line of sight
combos.dice_pool: Intelligence + Magic + lowest dots among combined schools
combos.effect: The caster returns the battlefield to its natural state. Every spell effect in sight (terrain, walls, zones, conjurations, and conditions caused by magic) with cast successes equal to or lower than this spell's cast successes ends immediately. Effects with higher cast successes lose successes equal to this spell's cast successes. The caster chooses whether their own and their allies' effects are spared.

combos.name: Heartfire Bond
combos.text: Many fires, one flame.
combos.range: Self and every ally within line of sight
combos.dice_pool: Intelligence + Magic + lowest dots among combined schools
combos.effect: The caster binds the mana of their allies into one shared fire. While active, every bound character may spend mana from any bound character's pool as if it were their own, with that character's permission. Each bound character's M/T is increased by the cast successes. If a bound character is Incapacitated, they are released from the bond. Countdown: lasts turns equal to half the mana spent, rounded up. Paying the upkeep during the Upkeep Phase freezes the countdown for that turn.

combos.name: Resurrection
combos.text: Light and shadow together pull a soul back across the threshold.
combos.dice_pool: Intelligence + Magic + lowest dots among combined schools
combos.effect: Can only be cast outside combat, on the body of someone who died without choosing to. The body must not be cremated or destroyed, and its mana countdown must not have reached 0. The caster needs at least as many successes as the days since death. On a success, the target returns to life with every Lethal box marked, takes 1 Sanity damage from the trauma of dying, and has 1 mana. A character who chose Blaze of Glory cannot be brought back.

combos.name: Nightfall
combos.text: The sun goes out, and it is not coming back for a while.
combos.range: All zones within line of sight
combos.dice_pool: Intelligence + Magic + lowest dots among combined schools
combos.effect: The world goes dark and cold across every zone the caster can see. Every zone in sight becomes Darkened. Each Upkeep Phase, every living enemy in sight must roll Fortitude + Endurance vs cast successes or take damage equal to excess successes, gain the Chilled condition, and lose mana equal to the cast successes. Undead in sight gain bonus dice equal to the cast successes on all rolls. Countdown: lasts turns equal to half the mana spent, rounded up. Paying the upkeep during the Upkeep Phase freezes the countdown for that turn.

combos.name: Starfall
combos.text: The sky falls, one star at a time, all at once.
